519832ea8d5d228c5db5035c48e1a3bd.title: Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm Inaugurated with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 2 (KCNA) -- The unshakable will and outstanding leadership ability of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea hastening the bright future of the overall development of socialism through exciting transformation across the country are bringing about entities of prosperity to be eternal as the wealth of the people while writing a new biography of mythical changes year after year.

At the time when the absolute trust in and devoted loyalty to the WPK, organizer and guide of all victories of the Korean people, are permeating the whole country advancing towards the glorious Party Congress, an ideal farm town with an unprecedented group of large greenhouses has been erected on the bank of River Amnok in the northwestern part of the country to greet the great auspicious event of inauguration.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un unfolded a grand plan to turn the area of Wihwa Island, where only sand dust was flying about by the strong river wind with natural disasters year by year, into a new model of regional development with great potential. He repeatedly visited the construction site to give energetic guidance to the gigantic development of the area and led the new generation in every aspect of their work to grow up to be reliable successors to the revolution and those strong in self-sustenance full of patriotic enthusiasm and confidence in their own strength through the construction process.

The Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm, a beautiful combination of a thousand and hundreds of modern greenhouses of different types, vegetable science research center, modern houses, various bases for cultural life and peculiar landscape, is another proud monumental edifice witnessing the history of great changes in the era of Kim Jong Un and a proud gift of loyalty presented by the young builders to the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
A ceremony for inaugurating the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm was held with splendor on February 1.

The venue of the ceremony was filled with high pride and soaring spirit of the young vanguard and soldier-builders who demonstrated once again the validity of the WPK's policy on regional development and the power for its implementation and the inexhaustible strength and enthusiasm of the Korean youth through the completion of a modern large-scale greenhouse vegetable producer.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
When he arrived at the venue of the ceremony, stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" burst out.

All the participants paid the highest tribute to the great father who opened up a new history of "Treasure Island", which will dynamically lead the regional economic development and the improvement of people's standard of living, after providing home of happiness full of people's laughter in the disaster-stricken area of Wihwa Island by devoting himself to the people with ardent love for them.

Present at the ceremony were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and other members of the central leadership body of the Party, soldier-builders and members of the youth shock brigade, officials and working people in North Phyongan Province and Sinuiju City, officials concerned and officials and employees of the farm.
Kim Chol Sam, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, addressed the ceremony.

The speaker said that the honorable and worthwhile construction of the greenhouse farm started by our Party for the good of the people has been finally concluded to present the spectacular view of a record grand greenhouse group in no more than a year. Today's inauguration is an epochal success symbolizing the eye-opening change of 2026 in which a vigorous advance toward greater goals will be continued, he added.

He extended warm thanks and congratulations reflecting the minds of all the people in the province to the reliable youth shock brigade members and soldier-builders who successfully built the modern large farm town and presented it to the Ninth Congress of the WPK as a gift, following the proud course in which they demonstrated the honour of vanguard in the struggle for prosperity of our state and the well-being of the people.

He noted that the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un worked out a grand plan to build the largest-ever greenhouse farm at the time when it was regarded as a miracle to build thousands of flats and solid embankment in the disaster-hit area. Kim Jong Un took every measure to provide the people in North Phyongan Province with the greenhouse farm, which made another leap forward in modernity, advanced nature and profitability as well as the architectural level compared with the already-built greenhouse farms, and visited the construction site several times to correct the shortcomings and energetically led the whole course of pioneering and creation, he added.

The young builders could build the leading large greenhouse farm in a short span of time with the indomitable spirit of overcoming difficulties and iron mettle and fighting spirit as the warm paternal affection of the benevolent teacher and dear father, who entrusted the whole construction of the greenhouse farm prioritized by the Party to the People's Army and young people and glorified the life of the patriotic youth, served as vital energies for unbounded struggle and inexhaustible strength of creating miracles, he said.

The sacred cause of regional development guided by the WPK is turning the barren land into a paradise and bringing the people's desire into a great reality without delay, the speaker said, ardently calling on all the participants to work more courageously, advance more vigorously and shape a more beautiful future true to the noble intention of the Party for the people.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a meaningful congratulatory speech.
In his speech he said:
"All of us now stand facing a great transformation, something that amazes even ourselves.
Do we have to use any other impressive expression or explanation to describe what we are seeing here?
We are witnessing the reality that needs no long explanation or expression.

This was where the local residents had suffered from flooding generation after generation, regarding it as their fate, and it is protected by a solid dam that would resist even the heaviest flooding on record. I am very happy and pleased that this has become a base for their new life, which they will work cheerfully to build up.
Our younger generation has proudly achieved a new transformation that is as beautiful as their youth and as honourable as their reputation.

Since the day when they committed themselves to the worthwhile, gigantic nature-remaking project, our soldiers and young people have devoted their youthful wisdom and enthusiasm to developing a precious part of their country; in doing so, they have also displayed their unshakable faith in socialism, confidence about the future and love for the country, thereby creating wealth from which our people will benefit for all ages.

Our young revolutionaries have chronicled a priceless struggle against the rigours of the construction project by displaying their dauntless courage and fervent zeal. But for their invaluable struggle we could hardly find ourselves standing in front of this great monumental structure today.

Our soldiers and young people have made a wonderful achievement of creation to be presented to the Ninth Party Congress, and thus proved again that they are fully qualified to be called the most powerful elite force and vanguard of our revolution.

The youthful vigour and warm sincerity, which have been passionately devoted to every inch of the expansive area of the island, will be remembered forever as an imprint of their priceless patriotic effort, and this will be rightfully etched in the history of our great state.

Availing myself of this significant opportunity, I express my respect, and send my best wishes on behalf of the country and people, to our dependable officers and soldiers and our young people for the patriotism and fidelity which they, as the main force of the gigantic construction struggle, have displayed in performing heroic feats with loyalty to the Party and the revolution and accelerating the dynamic onward advance of the times.

Along with the patriotic march of our proud builders for both today and tomorrow, our brave pioneers, the land of our country will be richer and more beautiful, and our ideals and determination will surely result in achieving steady advance and victory.
I once again express my heartfelt thanks to all of you.
This year, too, you should make redoubled efforts for our future that will always remain bright with the vigour of young Koreans, and also for the great era of transformation and prosperity.
In conclusion, I wish all the residents a happy life and offer congratulations once again on the inauguration of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm."

When Kim Jong Un finished his speech, all the participants cheered with enthusiasm, looking up to the great teacher and dear father who is taking warm care of all his children and bringing them up to be heroes of the times.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.
Fireworks were set off at the venue of the ceremony filled with deep reverence for the great Party Central Committee and excitement, beautifully decorating the sky in February.
Soldier-builders presented fragrant bouquets to Kim Jong Un out of boundless reverence and absolute loyalty.
Kim Jong Un then visited the Sinuiju Vegetable Science Research Center.
When he arrived, there was a thunderous cheer of enthusiasm.
Members of the youth shock brigade presented fragrant bouquets to him reflecting the unanimous gratitude and invariable will of succession of the young vanguard across the country.

Kim Jong Un warmly waved his hand and gave encouragement to the young vanguard who wrote a heroic biography of great changes in the northwestern part of the country and presented immortal dignity and glory to the congress of the motherly Party by responding to the call of the Party, the people and the revolution with revolutionary advance and courage and mettle peculiar to the brave and passionate youth.
There was a ceremony to commemorate the inauguration.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.
He went round the Sinuiju Vegetable Science Research Center together with leading officials.

He highly appreciated the scientific research group for greatly lowering production costs and consumption and making big profits through introduction of an intelligent integrated production system and valuable recycling technologies conducive to realizing the integration of management and production of the greenhouse farm.

Saying that the Sinuiju vegetable science research base has a very important duty in radically increasing the production of greenhouse vegetables of the country, he stressed the need for the base to properly play its role as an academic guidance unit and scientific research center that conducts scientific research into vegetables and also provides nationwide technical service for growing greenhouse vegetables.

In order to increase the production of greenhouse vegetables, it is needed to raise the scientific level of cultivation and closely combine the scientific researches into vegetables with production and actively introduce advanced technology and experience gained in the process into all greenhouse farms in the country to steadily expand the successes, he said.

It is the intention of the WPK to overtake the world not only in the size of greenhouse but also in the method of greenhouse vegetable cultivation, building up of technical foundations and production and thus make the people benefit from it as soon as possible, he said. And he clarified a series of tasks for the operation of greenhouse and scientific research into vegetables, including the issue of taking thorough scientific and technological measure for ensuring the quality, taste and nutritive value of greenhouse vegetables, the issue of directing efforts to widely spreading vegetable seeds of good varieties and the issue of establishing a national structure for unified guidance and management over many greenhouses across the country.
He met scientists and technicians who made contributions to the construction of the farm and officials of the central and field headquarters and had a photo session with them.
He went round various types of greenhouse buildings including solar greenhouse where fish farming is combined with vegetable cultivation.

Seeing the water tank full of fish, the floating cultivation frame where lettuce and nutritive cabbage grow green and the sea of such various vegetables as tomatoes, peppers and cucumbers, he said with pleasure that it is, indeed, a spectacular scene.

He said that the main thing in greenhouse vegetable production is a seed problem and that the farm should push forward with perseverance the work to breed different varieties of vegetable seeds and modernize equipment as a constant task.

Saying that we are now undergoing an important transformation process for radical changes in regions, he stressed that the construction of the farm is one of the hugest projects carried out during the eighth term of the WPK Central Committee and a precious wealth of prosperity showing the rapid development of our times in which struggles are being waged for epochal changes across the country with high goals and ideals.

Even a single blade of turf or a single tree in the farm is permeated with ardent love for the country of the service personnel and the youth and their spirit of devotedly implementing the Party's policies, he said, giving an instruction on officially commending the exemplary service personnel and young builders and conducting the work for reviewing and evaluating them on a large scale.
There was a ceremony of unveiling the monument to the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm.
Kim Jong Un unveiled the monument, heartily wishing that the farm would contribute to the economic development of the region and the improvement of its people's material life.
Lovely children presented him with bouquets of fragrant flowers reflecting the unanimous gratitude of the people in North Phyongan Province.
Kim Jong Un warmly wished the local people wellbeing and their bright future to be more civilized and richer.
That day, he had a photo session with the soldier-builders and young vanguard members involved in the construction of the farm.

All the participants fervently cheered with great reverence for him who put forward the army and young people in the vanguard of the gigantic construction struggle to transform a part of the country and led their revolutionary growth with loving care by repeatedly leaving the traces of his sacred guidance.

Kim Jong Un extended warm encouragement to the officers and men of the army and young builders, who successfully turned the island area into an ideal farm town in the new era with their ardent patriotic enthusiasm and labor efforts, cherishing the Party's grand plan and decision for regional development as the absolute truth.

He said that the eye-opening changes in the area of Wihwa Island are a living proof of the WPK's people-first policy and a proud record of the times on the undying feats and honorable achievements of the army and the youth who firmly support the cause of the Party with miracles of creation.

He said with pride that it is the strength and the highest pride of our Party, state and people that can not be compared with anything in the world to have successors to the revolution, a large contingent of genuine youth patriots who regard the life devoted to the prosperity of the country as the greatest honor and seek the worth and happiness of youth in the struggle for providing the people's wealth.

He stressed that the farm is another monument to the great struggle to go down in the sacred history of the Korean youth movement and a symbol of the valuable feats of the heroic youth in the new era, adding that the Korean revolution would be ever-victorious thanks to the reliable successors who have always been faithful to their mission and duty of the times with firm faith in and earnest desire for socialism.

He expressed expectation and belief that the youth, officers and soldiers would redouble their youthful strength, enthusiasm, wisdom and courage and more bravely struggle for the bright future of the powerful and beautiful country and the honor of the Korean youth.

When the photo session was over, all the young builders loudly chanted slogans calling for devotedly defending the Party Central Committee and implementing the Party policies, bearing deeper in their mind the immutable truth that the worthwhile life of youth and the brilliant happiness of all generations to come are on the road of remaining single-mindedly loyal to the ideas and leadership of Kim Jong Un.

Kim Jong Un hoped that he would meet with the admirable young builders in Pyongyang again, saying that the Ninth Congress of the glorious motherly Party is waiting for them who will enter in a dignified manner the capital city of the great state with labor gifts of loyalty.

Greatly encouraged by the warm loving care, trust and true heart of the great father, the young vanguard members and soldier-builders pledged to perform bigger miracles and labor feats in a new struggle record of 2026, upholding the Party's desire with more strenuous and dynamic labor efforts and miracle of creation.

Going round modern greenhouses, the vegetable science research center, various bases for cultural life and other places of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm where greening has been realized on a high level, the participants in the inauguration ceremony deeply grasped the standard of creation and the height of civilization set by the Party.

The inauguration of the farm serves as a significant occasion that confirmed the belief in invincibility and rosy future of our cause and struggle and strikingly demonstrated the irresistible might of socialist Korea dynamically advancing while bringing earlier the gigantic transformation in the regions under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. -0-

8c93dfb131a6ec16624d62b1e0d702d7.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Inauguration Ceremony of Samgwang Livestock Farm
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech at the inauguration ceremony of the Samgwang Livestock Farm.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Leading cadres of the Party and government and members of the Party central leadership, who are present here,
Comrades,
At this Samgwang Livestock Farm to be inaugurated today, we are seeing another peculiar development of the socialist countryside aspiring to advancement and modernity.
As all of you would feel while looking round it, the landscape that has completely changed the long-standing understanding of mountain village and rural life would be really impressive.
I think it is important on this occasion that we must renew our will and re-set on site the height of transformation, the level of change, we want to reach.
Whatever we do, we should do as we have done with this one.
This is the standard and epitome of a new change.
Have a look.

This far-flung village in Unjon County, which had nothing from of old to present other than a beautiful landscape and centuries-old rural backwardness, has been transformed into a standard entity, a blueprint, that enables us to visualize the future of modern countryside and modern stockbreeding. This is what we are seeing now.
We can say this is just a real transformation.

This Samgwang Livestock Farm, showcasing the developmental change in the countryside, constitutes another proud record and asset and wonderful creation, which highlights an aspect of the work of the Eighth Party Central Committee as much as a new large-scale greenhouse farm or leading electricity-generation base in terms of importance and significance.

First of all, I offer thanks to the builders of North Phyongan Province and scientists, technicians and officials of several sectors, who contributed to developing this unknown Samgwang-ri into an excellent model of socialist rural construction in faithful support of the rural revolution programme in the new era, which aims at the correct development of our state's agriculture and countryside.

And I extend warm greetings to all the agricultural workers of the Samgwang Livestock Farm and their families, who have settled down for a happy life earlier than others in the ideal village of civilization and rejuvenation that all other rural communities will surely greet before long.
Comrades,
This scenery of Samgwang-ri that has undergone transformation without giving much publicity is not something that has suddenly been created in a few years.
As is the case with the birth of everything new, painstaking efforts were made for this project, which was not all plain sailing.

To provide our people with the happiest life is the long-cherished desire of our Party. As a priority target to this end, the Party planned and gave assignments some years ago for the construction of a modern and standard livestock farm specializing in the production of dairy produce.

This project encompassed introduction of much advanced livestock farming technology and methods suited to our reality and presenting a completely new appearance of the modern countryside, even from its concept and implementation methods, going beyond the bounds of landscaping and building houses and public facilities as farms in various parts of the country are doing now. It demanded that we should not rely on the conventional ideas and precedents even from the designing stage.

Because of the deep-rooted habit of clinging to what are conventional and multiple challenges that faced us when we began to transform this farm, we had to renew the detailed targets and designs and repeat the building work accordingly on several occasions even when the project was underway full steam ahead.

We made such great efforts to transform this one farm never to build in a place of the country an object for publicity or tour, but to create a new starting point, innovative criterion, conducive to defining a future development orientation of our countryside and our livestock farming.
Of course, there are still some parts which require more efforts and something which should be done in order to perfectly modernize the Samgwang Livestock Farm.
However, the present reality will be enough to show the real purpose of the construction of this farm and its result, I think.

As I have mentioned above, it is important to create a proper standard, and whatever we plan and implement, we must get out of the habit of doing everything in an unscientific and slipshod way and without a clear standard.

For the successful attainment of the goal of this trial project, I assigned it to a major department of the Party Central Committee and got it to oversee the project; the department carried out the assignment correctly.
The Samgwang Livestock Farm is a model of modern farm village and modern livestock farming, immaculate in all aspects.
It can be said that this farm has smashed the traditional concept of animal husbandry, crop farming and rural village that had long been regarded as a matter of course.
As it is put on a highly IT, intelligent, intensive and industrial footing, the farm is incomparably superior to other livestock farming bases that rank top in the country now.
Gone forever are the days when it was regarded as normal for the keepers to climb mountains and graze animals, rain or shine.

This farm has introduced the method of raising goats and milch cows indoors to produce milk regardless of the seasonal change while economizing on labour and area. The keepers correctly conduct tending of each animal, like feeding and anti-epizootic work, in a scientific, technological and industrial way while operating the control system in modern animal sheds. And all the milch cows and goats are of superior breeds.

In addition, milking, conveying and processing lines are fully automated; feed processing and production and most of the other lines are done as they are at an industrial factory; and this farm has also a modern stockbreeding research branch. I think all these are most ideal for increased production and the development of stockbreeding technology.

This is the first farm in the sector of raising grass-eating domestic animals to achieve the definite integration of science and technology with production and realization of a food production cycle based on animal husbandry and crop farming and the establishment of an intelligent integrated production system capable of real-time monitoring, analyzing and controlling the state of production and management activities to suit its characteristics as a livestock farm.

These advantages constitute a factor favourable for promoting transformation of the agricultural workers on a working class pattern and improvement of their advanced and cultured level, which we always regard as an important task in resolving the rural and farmer problems.

As all the elements of modernization of livestock farming have been realized on an unprecedentedly high level, this will soon become a profitable farm, whose increase in revenue and improvement of employees' living standards based on high productivity are harmoniously combined with national interests.

At present, we can say that we built the Kwangchon Chicken Farm as a model of our country's poultry farming a few years ago, and that we have built this Samgwang Livestock Farm as a model of raising of grass-eating domestic animals.

I am really happy that this farm will uninterruptedly produce cheese, butter and other dairy produce, which were inconceivable at the farm, to contribute to the dietary life of our people, the children in particular.

Samgwang-ri, a modernized livestock farming base, is an exemplary and ideal rural community furnished with all the functions and criteria as a regional unit equal to one-4 000th of the country in area.

To say nothing of the seat of Samgwang-ri, where sections for education and leisure activities and residential quarters are distributed in an orderly way, the buildings of all branch farms and workteams and processing places have been built to be perfect in architectural aesthetics and suitable for their functions and purposes. All these features serve as a wonderful textbook for the urbanization of the countryside and the civilization of mountain villages.
Flawless are such public facilities as school, kindergarten, hospital, pharmacy, shop, hall of culture and neighbourhood-serving amenities.
The farm has also set an example in creating an ecological environment and in landscaping.
It is the correct implementation of the Party's policy that the bare land in all sections except the land under cultivation has been carpeted with cover plants in harmony with good species of trees.

Afforestation and water conservation have been carried out to cover the mountains with thick forests and turn the shores of the reservoir and river into places, into distinctive parks, for recreational activities and power-generating facilities relying on renewable energy have been set up.
Such is a view of Samgwang-ri, which even a painter with outstanding imagination can hardly portray in his work.

Embodied in every element and every corner of this farm are the policy-oriented requirements to transplant the advanced and modern qualities into the countryside. Indeed, as a comprehensive model of rural transformation, the farm clearly indicates the ideals and goal of socialist rural construction at the present stage.
Comrades,
The eye-opening appearance of this transformed farm teaches us something very great.

The significance is not confined to the transformation of a mountainous farm; what is more significant is that it has opened the way to transformation and development suited to the specific features of the regions and farms and boosts their self-confidence, ambition and courage.

The transformation in Samgwang, which has completely changed the concepts of production mode, working life and rural civilization, clearly indicates what we should do in the future and on which level we should do them.

What I make clear here is that we do not intend to confine ourselves to putting forward and giving publicity to this rural area as we did in the past with some exemplary units, but to fundamentally transform all the rural communities across the country with this area as the origin and starting point.

To this end, we have to duly realize once again why our rural areas are yet to be freed from impoverishment even though, from a historical point of view, many Party's policies on rural problems have been advanced and the struggle to carry out the socialist rural theses has been conducted for over half a century.
Frankly speaking, it is no exaggeration to say that we paid lip service to rural construction in the past.
To take a typical example in this regard, each province has done nothing other than face-lifting a few rural villages in a symbolic way.
A policy that is hardly possible to be executed is nothing other than an empty theory; is it a viable policy?
The state investment in, and assistance to, the countryside has been conducted in a sporadic, temporary and showy way; this is another mistake made in rural construction.
Officials have pushed forward with rural construction without any correct goal, standard and methodology.

In particular, they have failed to take effective measures for raising in a sustainable way agricultural productivity, a key and basic task in rural construction, and consolidating stage by stage the material and technical foundations of the countryside.

To speak about livestock farming, the slogan for obtaining meat from grass was raised already in the postwar period and a fuss has been made about solving without delay the problem of meat and eggs by building large-scale livestock farming bases in different parts of the country, but none has paid off.
Ten years have passed since a livestock farming base was built in the Sepho area, but it is the same case with it.

The livestock farming sector, virtually devoid of the technology for developing superior breeds, has not established a proper system of breeding nor has it done as it should the work of preserving and supplementing the superiority of these breeds.

Complaining about the lack of grain fodder and protein fodder, the sector has not buckled down to solving the fodder problem; the result is that every province fails to meet the elementary demand owing to the lack of fodder though they have several livestock farming bases with a large production capacity.

Our struggle goal for rural construction cannot be attained simply by means of any rhetoric or high-sounding slogans. It can be attained through our uninterrupted efforts for substantial and sustainable development and transformation in agricultural productivity, rural environment and the agricultural workers' living.
We have no time to be engaged in empty talk any longer. We must struggle steadily and bring about transformation continuously so as to create without fail changed environment and improved entities.
To make the members of the central leadership of the Party accept this idea by seeing the actual object and reality--this is why I have come here with them.
Comrades,
Since the rural revolution programme in the new era was advanced, a new history of transformation has been opened and a number of conspicuous successes have been achieved in our countryside.

Rural housing construction has been conducted for three successive years, with the result that modern villages have sprung up in all cities and counties and changes have begun to be made in all realms including grain production structure, mechanization, irrigation, farming methods and the level of ideological consciousness and civilization of the agricultural workers.

As the implementation of the regional development policy is underway full steam and in a simultaneous way, the socio-economic conditions for promoting and backing up the development and rejuvenation of the countryside are becoming more matured and enriched.
But, we should not think that we can carry out as we planned the historic tasks of our rural revolution by continuing to do as we are doing now.
Just this Samgwang-ri clearly indicates the prospect of the socialist rural development we are going to attain.

What we have to do from now on is to expand and develop the experience and successes we have gained in the course of building the Samgwang Livestock Farm, and thus put rural development onto a new qualitative transformation stage.

Only when the agricultural workers enjoy all the benefits of modern science and technology and civilization in all realms, can we say that the goal of the rural revolution programme in the new era has been attained and the socialist rural development policy has succeeded in the true sense of the word.

Therefore at the present stage, we should launch a vigorous struggle to transform all the rural communities across the country in all realms of construction of houses and education, public health and leisure facilities, land administration and eco-environmental protection, to say nothing of agricultural production, as we have done in Samgwang-ri.
A major hallmark of the modern countryside can be said to be the modernization, informatization and industrialization of agriculture.

It is necessary to readjust and fully improve the land, roads, irrigation facilities and the electric supply system, which are directly linked to agricultural production, in a neat and efficient way, step up the comprehensive mechanization of farm operations in keeping with the topographical features, and actively introduce into them the automation and AI technology.

Now that the enthusiasm for scientific farming prevails in the whole country and it has become an actual task to apply IT to farm work, farms should follow the road of establishing a network infrastructure and scientific management system for agricultural production.
They should also build workteam buildings, greenhouses and other bases for production activities, production facilities, in a neat way and make them multifunctional.
Another major hallmark of the modern countryside is its urbanized, civilized and advanced characters.

At present, dwelling houses and public buildings are being built in rural communities in cities and counties across the country every year, but it can be said to be just the beginning, if they are to be built genuinely as nicely as those in urban areas.

We should properly form farm village sections in keeping with the relevant regional features, construct all the buildings and other elements to suit the modern aesthetic sense, and actively transplant the essential elements of cultured living, which have so far been regarded as part of civilization only in urban areas, into rural areas, so as to reduce the gap between towns and the countryside.

We are going to modernize rural areas with an eye to promoting the convenience of the agricultural workers as much as possible and enabling them to substantially enjoy modern civilization; therefore, we should ensure perfect quality of all buildings and other creations.

To this end, provinces, cities and counties should direct efforts into building up design and construction forces that are indispensable to rural construction, increasing the proportion of construction work done by machines, and expanding the capacity for producing building materials.

Even if the working conditions and living environment improve, it does not mean that the level of ideological awareness, technical qualifications and civilization of the people will go up of their own accord.

As our Party consistently stresses, we should keep stepping up the three revolutions--ideological, technological and cultural--to make agricultural workers full-fledged masters of the modern countryside and the driving force of the rural revolution, who are prepared ideologically, spiritually, culturally and technologically.
In other words, we should transform them on a revolutionary and working-class pattern and make them well versed in science and technology.

The departments of the Party Central Committee, ministries, national agencies and design and other relevant sectors should intensify guidance and assistance for rural development from the standpoint of building up all farms in a modern style like the Samgwang Livestock Farm.

By doing so, we should accomplish the historic cause of turning all the rural communities into rich and civilized socialist paradise, ideal land good to work and live in, in our generation without fail.
We should definitely transform the country's animal husbandry into a modern one of the world level.

Our Party and state have so far built a large number of livestock farming bases and put much effort to them in order to amply supply our people with meat, eggs and milk, but with the present low level and weak foundations it is impossible to meet the people's qualitative and quantitative needs, and yet it is all the more difficult to bring animal husbandry up to the world standard.
Today, however, we have gained confidence, and the future is promising.
There is no need for us to have a faint hope or heave a sigh, comparing ours to the developed animal husbandry of other countries.
We have already built by ourselves a model of modern animal husbandry attaining the world level, and in the course of this we have accumulated precious experience and drawn valuable lessons.

Our Party already set superior breeds, sufficient feed, a scientific approach to rearing and comprehensive veterinary services as four key factors in developing livestock farming, and has worked to this end. We should add to these factors the making of production and management informatized and intelligent.

The reality of the Samgwang Livestock Farm shows that no one can discuss about the world level unless production and management of such farms are made informatized and intelligent, even if they are equipped with the elements essential for the development of animal husbandry.

That is why all the units in the animal husbandry sector should go in the direction of establishing an intelligent production system by combining modern information means and equipment with overall processes and elements of livestock farming like the Samgwang Livestock Farm.
In a word, the livestock farming sector should set the new five key factors as the basic direction for putting animal husbandry on a modern and advanced footing.
It is a prerequisite for the development of animal husbandry to steadily secure animals of superior breeds.

The breeding sector and production units should introduce advanced techniques and methods to develop and propagate good breeds of domestic animals, whose milk and meat are of high quality and which are highly productive, and establish a strict system for preserving pedigree breeds for preventing them from being degenerated.
Fodder supply is as important as the issue of breeds in developing animal husbandry.
Now is the time for us to take the road of solving the issue of fodder by intensive and industrial methods.
We should improve grass fields effectively, cultivate grasses of high nutritive value, and raise the proportion of mechanization in the management of grass fields so as to boost their productivity.

We should also adopt intensive and industrial methods in the cultivation of grasses and fodder processing, including the introduction of continuous production of grasses in their cultivation grounds and various fodder production techniques according to the breeds of domestic animals, seasons and the individual animals.

In the past it was regarded as a traditional concept that there must be pastures and roads in order to raise grass-eating domestic animals on a large scale. Now is the time for us to boldly get rid of this convention.

In view of the situation of our country with a limited area of grass fields and the global development trend of animal husbandry, it is profitable to encourage and expand the raising of animals indoors.
I have already mentioned this at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Party.
In doing so, we can drastically increase the number of domestic animals per keeper and raise them in a scientific, intensive and specialized way.

In keeping with the introduction of indoor raising methods and the developing level of intensive production, the livestock farming units should pay close attention to developing the technologies of treating and reusing the excrement, so as to prevent environmental pollution and perfect the food production cycle of animal husbandry and crop farming.
The reality, in which livestock farming is being put on an intensive and industrial footing, makes a higher demand on the anti-epizootic work.

These days, not a few epidemic diseases are spreading worldwide, threatening livestock farming. Our country, too, has suffered a considerable damage from them. By drawing a lesson from this and with a view that anti-epizootic work equates to production, we should decisively raise the level of modernization and scientification of disinfecting imported domestic animals and take scientific and strict anti-epizootic measures in livestock farming units.
In addition, we should integrate the livestock production and processing, increase the range of dairy produce and processed meat, and thoroughly guarantee their quality.
From this angle, the basic orientation of our livestock farming is to develop specialized livestock farming on an IT, intelligent, intensive and industrial basis.

The livestock production at farms and individual households play a considerable part as much as specialized livestock farming units do in fully satisfying the demand for livestock products. Therefore, we should proactively encourage these kinds of livestock farming and apply scientific raising and tending methods to them to the maximum.

We should take economic and practical measures nationwide to improve the role of stockbreeding science and education sectors and research units, develop and produce a large number of modern machines for livestock farming, and provide a sustainable driving force to the efforts for reenergizing livestock farming.

It is important to direct much effort to building up the ranks of technical personnel, the most essential and strategic resource for the development of livestock farming, while further reinforcing the systems for the guidance over and sci-tech dissemination for the country's livestock farming and adjusting irrational spaces and elements with regard to this.
It is necessary to effectively organize the work of introducing and propagating across the country the experience and successes gained in modernizing the Samgwang Livestock Farm.

There are livestock farms in provinces which were built scores of years ago and livestock farming bases which have been newly built. It will be a good idea for all of them to come here to learn from this farm and make a fresh start in keeping with their specific situations.

If we build profitable livestock farming bases in succession in all provinces by drawing on the experience of building this farm wonderfully and thus give a spur to modernizing the country's livestock farming, it will develop by leaps and bounds.

In this way we can set the goal of supplying all the time milk, butter, cheese and other dairy produce of various kinds and processed meat to all the population, to say nothing of not only children but also primary and middle school students.
Comrades,
We are now confident in and fully optimistic about the development of the countryside and livestock farming, but it will not be easy at all to achieve it.
However, we should regard this as something we must do by all means.

As you see firsthand the changes in the countryside in the run-up to the Party Congress, all of you attending this ceremony should boost your confidence and harden your common will to open a new chapter of socialist rural construction.

Officials should fully discharge their duty and role in the efforts for developing livestock farming and the countryside. By doing so, they can make this ceremony an important occasion and a new, powerful starting point in expanding and stepping up the rural revolution in the new era.
Workers of the Samgwang Livestock Farm,
You will be the first in our country to enjoy the benefits of modernized countryside.

I am convinced that the workers and officials of the farm will continue to elevate their pride in having written a new chapter of transformation in the chronicles of their region into an unexcelled patriotic zeal and work hard for a greater development and prosperity of their native place and for a rosier future of their posterity.
I wish all the families in Samgwang-ri only pleasure and happiness in their dear place which will prosper forever and become more beautiful. -0-

b2ba9476239e231d8e09710b4a810b48.title: Samgwang Livestock Farm Inaugurated in DPRK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- The rural areas across the DPRK are undergoing changes one after another to present new scenery of civilization all the year round, thanks to the steady implementation of the new programme for the rural revolution in the new era set forth by the Workers' Party of Korea. Against this backdrop, Samgwang-ri of Unjon County in North Phyongan Province has turned into a modern stockbreeding base and beautiful socialist ideal land to greet the auspicious moment of its inauguration.

Fashionable houses are standing in rows adding to the sentiments peculiar to the countryside in the fairyland villages, alongside different branch farms, processing grounds, breeding blocks, cultural and welfare establishments, solar power station, office building, house of culture, kindergarten, school, hospital, pharmacy and other public buildings. They are all impeccable in terms of architectural beauty and magnificent for being in good harmony. The stockbreeding farm is a model of the era to be proud of, which set a new standard in the socialist rural construction and the development of the livestock farming.

The eye-opening transformation in Samgwang area clearly showing the rapid development of the socialist countryside is proud fruition of the noble devotion of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is confidently ushering in a bright future of Korean-style socialism with his outstanding ideas, theory and energetic leadership and another clear proof of the validity and vitality of the WPK's policy on rural construction.

An inauguration ceremony of the Samgwang Livestock Farm under the North Phyongan Provincial Rural Economy Committee, built as a model of socialist rural construction and development of livestock farming in the new era, was held with splendour on February 2.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.

All the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" out of their deep reverence for the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, the benevolent father of all the people who is bringing about a new appearance of great prosperity, in which all the rural areas across the country change and thrive, by making endless journey of devotion day and night with his warmest love for the country and the people.

Present at the ceremony were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and other members of the central leadership body of the Party, officials of North Phyongan Province and Unjon County, working people and employees of the farm.
Kim Jong Un made a historic speech in commemoration of the inauguration of the Samgwang Livestock Farm.

Today we are seeing another peculiar development of the socialist countryside aspiring to advancement and modernity at the newly-built Samgwang Livestock Farm, he said, adding this is a new standard and epitome clearly showing the height of transformation and the level of changes we want to reach.

He referred to the purpose and important significance of the construction of the Samgwang Livestock Farm, which was started to create a new starting point, innovative criterion, conducive to defining a future development orientation of our countryside and our livestock farming in the light of the lessons learned from the rural construction in the past.

Samgwang-ri clearly indicates the prospect of the socialist rural development we are going to attain and we should put rural development onto a new qualitative transformation stage by expanding and developing the experience and successes gained in the course of building the Samgwang Livestock Farm, he said, specifying different tasks for implementing the socialist rural development policy and definitely turning the livestock farming of the country into a modern one of world level.

When Kim Jong Un finished his speech, all the participants raised enthusiastic cheers with great emotion and pleasure of receiving the immortal guidelines indicating the clear strategy for the enlarged implementation of the WPK's programme for the rural revolution and the development of stockbreeding in the new era.
Upon authorization of Kim Jong Un, Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet, cut the inauguration tape.
Kim Jong Un extended warm congratulations to the residents in the region who came to lead a blessed life in the place wonderfully transformed into a socialist paradise.
He, together with leading officials, went round the first branch of the Samgwang Livestock Farm, protected cultivation floor, milk production ground, etc.

Watching the delightful picture in which milk cows and goats of supra-species are being bred, he said that the main thing in stockbreeding is also breed and it is needed to establish a nationwide system of providing supra species and conduct the work to preserve pure breeds in a scientific way.

He said that it is necessary to positively introduce such advanced stock-breeding technology as an intelligent management system of individual cow, goat, sheep and others and steadily perfect the Korean-style livestock production system and IT system.

In line with the intention of the Party which set as the five-point link in the development of stockbreeding the securement of supra-species, full supply of fodder, scientific raising and tending and thorough epizootic prevention together with the work of putting production and management control on an IT and intelligent basis, the farm should direct big efforts to lowering the production cost and improving the quality of products by optimizing and modernizing the technical control, management of equipment, raising and tending and management of fodder and thus ensure that the validity and vitality of the WPK's stockbreeding policy are proved by clear production result in the future, too.

Saying that scientific stockbreeding precisely means the increased production of livestock products, he stressed that the farm should steadily usher in a new phase of the development of stockbreeding and make uninterrupted innovations and progress, regarding it as a priority task to bolster up the scientific and technological capabilities in the production, management and operation.

The Samgwang Livestock Farm should become a standard-bearer standing in the van of the whole country under the uplifted banner for implementing the Party's stockbreeding policy, he said, giving precious instructions for the management control of the farm including the issue of steadily developing the technology for recycling waste, the issue of creating new standards in the analysis and control of quality and the issue of stirring up the atmosphere of competitive development as well as exchange of experience among major stockbreeding farms.

He said that like this farm, modern and industrialized elements are being now positively introduced in rural areas and it is necessary to positively promote such trend and make it a policy. Noting that it is the enlarging and deepening of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era to develop the country's stockbreeding in a specialized way including the integration of production system at stockbreeding farm, the increase of veterinary medicine production and the establishment of a new stockbreeding information technology research unit, he clarified the ways for its implementation.
He learned about the milk production at the farm.

Appreciating that the farm is ensuring the environment of stabilized production and profitability through introduction of an intelligent milk production system based on the virtual physical production system, he said that lots of good experiences conducive to putting the production line on an intelligent and IT basis have been created recently, and this work should be steadily developed with a clear purposeful orientation.

Having a taste of milk product, he said that it tastes better than the products made in the capital city and it is very great for the unknown farm to mass-produce 10-odd kinds of milk products such as butter, cheese, milk powder and yoghurt. He added that he feels great pride to think that such good milk products would be supplied to the children and people.

Enjoying the picturesque panorama of the farm including modern rural dwelling houses, he said with pleasure that it is wonderful and it is a deep and quiet landscape arousing a sentiment peculiar to the region and that the Samgwang Livestock Farm is a model edifice which can represent the socialist rural area in the new era and an ideal cultural farm to the envy of a town.

Noting that to spruce up all the rural villages of the country to be clear in its Korean-style socialist nature and regional characteristics is a strategically important plan prioritized by the Party in order to provide the rural villagers with good living environment and achieve the overall development of the country, he said that if modern villages boasting of their unique architectural beauty are built one year after another in the countryside, not only the living environment of the agricultural workers but also their ideological consciousness and civilization level will undergo an epochal change along with transformation in the appearance of the country.

Calling for building the rural villages to be impeccable without a parallel even in the distant future and to be advantageous in all aspects, he expressed his unshakable will to more strongly and confidently propel the overall development of the countryside.

Recalling that a model greenhouse vegetable farm was built in the area of the Wihwa Island and a new standard of stockbreeding development was set in the Samgwang area, he said it is the Korean-style traditional development mode and law to create a model and generalize it to the whole country. When this is well embodied in an organic manner in the construction of rural villages and regions, more epochal progress will be made in the implementation of the Party's programme for the rural revolution in the new era and policy of regional development, he added.

He stressed the need to further enhance the sense of mission and responsibility for the revolutionary cause and redouble their efforts to intensify the state guidance on the rural and regional construction, promote its constant development and ensure the state-sponsored investment and support, thus making sure that the rural construction policy and regional development policy of the Party become a historical review adding a proud page to the nation-building history.

Looking round the smart and cozy rural dwellings, breeding blocks, milk-producing ground and educational and leisure facilities, members of the central leadership body of the Party were assured of the rosier future of the socialist countryside that will prosper with each passing day under the outstanding guidance of Kim Jong Un and renewed their pledge to more creditably fulfill their duty in implementing the Party policies.

The inauguration of the Samgwang Livestock Farm strikingly demonstrated the ambition and executive power of the WPK to transform all the rural villages of the country into the ideal ones under socialism, good to live and work in, and marked an epochal turning point of great significance in putting the national stockbreeding on an advanced basis. -0-

c7dba33eccdd288e162f19553d9f06a8.title: 27th Politburo Meeting of Eighth C.C., WPK Held
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- The 27th Meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was held at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee on Feb. 7.
Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK.
Present there as observers were vice directors of major departments of the C.C., WPK who are members of the relevant panels of the preparatory committee for the congress.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided the meeting.
Upon authorization of Kim Jong Un, Jo Yong Won, Presidium member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, presided over the meeting.
The Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee decided on the following agenda items:
First, "On the deliberation of qualifications of the delegates to the Ninth Congress of the WPK"
Second, "On the deliberation of composition of the presidium, platform and secretariat for the Ninth Congress of the WPK"
Third, "On the deliberation of schedule of the Ninth Congress of the WPK"
Fourth, "On the deliberation of documents to be submitted to the Ninth Congress of the WPK"
On the basis of hearing reports on the agenda items and discussing them, the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee approved relevant decisions.

Kim Jong Un made an affirmative appreciation of the fact that the relevant panels of the congress preparatory committee have effectively pushed ahead with the preparations for the congress in every way, and clarified the principled issues and detailed tasks for the successful holding of the congress.

The Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee adopted with unanimous approval a decision on opening the Ninth Congress of the WPK in Pyongyang, the capital of the revolution, in late February 2026. -0-

7f7b8885103b15df3eff07e432a8130d.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Ministry of National Defence
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- The Korean People's Army, the ever-victorious elite ranks, has formulated the new concept of a powerful army and a new law of victory with its unique ideological and moral superiority of remaining absolutely loyal to the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, unparalleled mass heroism, matchless bravery and indomitable fighting spirit, and the honour of the revolutionary armed forces has reached its peak for its absolute might. It is marking its founding anniversary with pride, adding a page of shining victories and miracles to the great army-building history.

The KPA is adding to the greatness of the Party and the state and ushering in a new era of prosperity and development in the vanguard of the revolution advancing through struggle and transformation for the eternal prosperity of the country and the well-being of the people, true to the sacred letters embroidered on its glorious colors. Its legendary feats and dynamic advance constitute a great pride of the state and the people and a symbol of their strong dignity and inexhaustible strength.

Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, paid a congratulatory visit to the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK on February 8, the 78th founding anniversary of the KPA to congratulate and encourage all officers and men of the army.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the WPK Central Committee.

All the commanding officers were filled with boundless excitement and joy as they came to greet the great brilliant commander visiting the Ministry of National Defence with his ardent desire to put his trust, deepest ever for the existence and development of the revolutionary armed forces, in them again on the significant army-founding day.
There was a solemn ceremony of greeting the Supreme Commander.
Kim Jong Un reviewed the guard of honour of the Korean People's Army.
The Ministry of National Defence presented him with bouquets of fragrant flowers reflecting the boundless reverence of all the service personnel of the People's Army for him.
He was courteously greeted by major commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and commanders of the KPA large combined units.
He reviewed the flags of victory, symbols of honour of the large combined units and combined units of the KPA at all levels.

All the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the greatest commander in the world who has led the Juche-based cause of building a powerful army to victory with his outstanding army-building idea and commanding art, fully demonstrating the dignity, might and fame of the armed forces and adding eternal glory to the long army-building history.
The national flag of the DPRK was hoisted.
The guard of honour of the KPA marched with pride, being reviewed by the Supreme Commander.
Kim Jong Un delivered a significant speech on the occasion of army-founding day.
In the speech, he said:
All the generals and other officers and soldiers of the heroic armed forces of the Republic,
Generals and other officers at the Ministry of National Defence, the supreme commanding organ of the Korean People's Army,
I congratulate you on the February 8 Army Founding Day.

This day, when we recall with pride our army's heroic building history and its ever-victorious course, is a revolutionary holiday which is significantly celebrated not only by the service personnel but also by all the people throughout the country.

On behalf of the Party and government, I extend warm congratulations and militant greetings to all the officers and soldiers on the occasion of Army Founding Day in reflection of my mind always thankful to our army that is playing every role and making infinite devotion for our great state and people, shouldering a great mission and heavy duty incomparable to those of other armies in the world.

I also pay my respects to the responsible efforts of the commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and the military and political cadres of the large combined units, who are doing their best to perfectly embody the military lines and policies of the Party in the military and political activities of the entire army.

In particular, I extend warm encouragement and congratulations to the commanding officers and other combatants of the overseas special operations units, who are carrying out the order of their homeland in combat positions in the faraway alien land, staking the honour of their heroic army, as I want to see them all the more today.
Comrades,
We greet this day every year, but today I have come here with a really special feeling.
As it is the day we are celebrating in the lead-up to the Ninth Party Congress, which will open soon, I feel more keenly the greatness and preciousness of our army.

In looking back upon the victorious journey of our army over the past turbulent five years as it has always been since its founding, today's glory would never be conceivable separated from the enormous role our army has played. At this thought, I can hardly find enough words to express my heartfelt thanks to all the officers and soldiers of our army.
Officers and soldiers of the KPA,

You have done really great things to support the Party's cause and defend the security of the national sovereignty and safety of the people in the vanguard of the pioneering struggle, the struggle for achieving transformation, which was challenging year after year.
I would like to praise you for having done greater things last year than you had done in all the years of the past.

Last year was a year especially filled with unheard-of dramatic events and distinguished feats that could be performed only by our army. For this, it can be called a year when the Party's and people's trust in and affection for their army grew stronger and greater.

Our army has proved before the times and history that it is its mettle and original features to quicken more enormous and vigorous strides for loyalty and feats the greater the trust in and expectation for it is.
As you are all prepared for, this is a year of tremendous transformation, when the fighting front of our army will become more widened and which will demand more strenuous efforts.
Likewise, the coming five years that will be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the Party will be years when our army's outstanding role that no one else can perform will become further enhanced.

Our Party is always filled with confidence and feels proud as if it had won the world, as it has put in the vanguard of the struggle to create a new world the revolutionary armed forces, our army, boundlessly faithful to its cause.
Comrades,
On the occasion of Army Founding Day, I offer my warm congratulations once again to all the officers and soldiers of the army, and I hope you will make more strenuous efforts.
Our brave army will further accelerate its advance for the country and the people, and its fighting course will be adorned with brilliant feats and fame.
Long live the heroic Korean People’s Army!

His speech, filled with profound trust and affection of him who always places the armed forces of the Republic in the vanguard of the drive for implementing the sacred cause of the WPK, deeply moved all the service personnel.

When he finished his speech, the service personnel chanted the slogan of loyalty to him and sang a revolutionary military song in chorus as a token of their militant enthusiasm to dedicate themselves to ensuring the eternal prosperity and security of their socialist country and the happiness of the people by regarding as stimulants of their growth and lifeblood of their destiny the trust and loving care shown by him, who injects vitality into the revolutionary armed forces to be strong, signally glorious and invincible, and by becoming the service personnel, strong in their faith, moral obligation and ideology, who never deviate from the path indicated by the Party Central Committee, fully embodying its revolutionary idea.
He had a photo session with the major commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and commanders of the large combined units of the KPA.
A ceremonial performance was given by the central military band of the Ministry of National Defence.

The festive mood on the Day of Army was further deepened by the performers' rhythmic formations ever changing to the tune of revolutionary military songs full of the militant spirit, reminiscent of a bugle signal to the entire army for an advance toward a new victory, and smart and amazing rifle-handling skills shown by KPA honour guard members.
Kim Jong Un had a photo taken with the generals and other officers of the headquarters of the ministry in commemoration of the army-founding day.

All the participants paid the highest glory and respect to the Supreme Commander who has led the service personnel step by step with his warm encouragement so that they win great victories and perform immortal exploits in the forefront of the struggle for carrying out the great cause of building a rich country with a strong army.

Kim Jong Un said that the course of eye-opening development and offensive advance of our country, which has brought about miraculous transformation and remarkable successes during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee, is associated with the undying exploits of the KPA service personnel, admirable sons and daughters of the country and the people, who have made, by their ennobling devotion and priceless feats, a breakthrough for victory and effected new upsurges in the revolution in order to bring the great transformation to be seen in the future to present reality.

From the army-founding generation to the present generation, the revolutionary nature of our army voluntarily shouldering the heavy burden for the revolution has never changed and to be proud of is the militant path it has covered by making a bold advance to gain a series of victories in the face of trials and difficulties, and yet more worthwhile and glorious is the path ahead of it, he said, adding that the worksites of gigantic struggle, to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the Party, are calling the service personnel of the KPA, the strongest in the world, invincible and heroic.

He expressed belief that the KPA, which has deemed the decisions of the Party the absolute truth and supreme military order and always said "Yes" in response, will glorify the current era by performing miraculous exploits transcending heroism of all historical ages in the ensuing new struggle and add lustre to the honour of the present generation to be admired by posterity.

All the participants loudly chanted the slogan of "Death-defying Defence", out of their firm pledge to add eternal brilliance to the great fame and glory of the KPA which has adorned the past years with legendary victories and miracles by dint of its unique spirit and soul, always living up to its sacred title - army of the Party and army of the people.
Kim Jong Un watched a sports game of commanding officers of the ministry held in commemoration of the army-founding day.
Then he met the retired generals invited to the celebrations.

Saying that recorded in every page of the long army-building history, which always goes alongside the leadership history of the Party, is the ennobling devotion made by the retired generals who faithfully upheld the Party and the country with their unbounded self-sacrificing indomitable spirit during their long service in the revolutionary army, he had a photo session with them who dedicated themselves to bolstering up the military muscle.

His congratulatory visit to the Ministry of National Defence was a meaningful occasion for renewing the noble sense of mission of the service personnel and redoubling their efforts to remain faithful to their role as the vanguard of the revolutionary armed forces in the sacred struggle for safeguarding the national sovereignty and right to development and the people's destiny and future. -0-

dfd365724e8982bcbcc40e4d68c66ed2.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations under Construction
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations under construction on Feb. 13.

He was greeted on the spot by Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, commanding officers of the military units involved in the construction and officials of the designing and creation units.
Going round the construction site, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un acquainted himself in detail with the progress made in construction and creation and installation of sculptures.

Highly appreciating that the outer wall sculptural decorations were created well to preserve the theme-specific features, he said that the matchless bravery and mass heroism displayed by soldiers of the Korean People's Army, involved in the overseas military operations, must be imposingly etched in history as a banner of invincibility.

The Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations is, before being a simple architectural structure, the crystal of the noble respect, paid by our Party, country and people to the sacred souls of the heroic martyrs who will be immortal for all ages, and the platform of dignity and honour for respectfully exalting their worthwhile life, he added.
Stressing the need to create all elements to be ideologically and artistically perfect in minute detail, he clarified a series of tasks and ways on modification.

He called upon the service personnel, designers and creators, involved in the construction of the memorial museum, to deeply cherish the profound feelings of respect of the Party and people and successfully build the museum into a sacred monument, an edifice representative of the era, which will be glorified eternally as a symbol of the feats and immortality of the fallen fighters. -0-

f06013636c8ad997e355e9926b49a695.title: Saeppyol Street Inaugurated with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- Saeppyol Street has made an imposing appearance in an excellent location in Hwasong area of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK. It is a monumental architectural group reflecting the strong will of all the people to convey forever the shining star-like feats of the heroes who unhesitatingly sacrificed their lives for the immortal honour and eternal prosperity of their great motherland during the overseas military operations.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un personally initiated the construction of a new street for their bereaved families and named it to glorify the precious life of fine sons of the country generation after generation. He also energetically guided the whole course of its construction so that every element of buildings shows the warm sincerity of our Party and state for the families that the brave fighters left behind.

The unique architectural groups are presenting a spectacular scene as high-, medium- and low-storied apartment buildings with formative artistic, practical and convenient value and public buildings such as commercial and neighbourhood-serving amenities are in ideal harmony. It represents an immortal picture showing the noble moral obligation and fervent love of our Party determined to glorify the bereaved families as well as the heroes respected and revered by all the people and enable them to enjoy to the full the beautiful life in the motherland the martyrs protected at the cost of their lives.
An inauguration ceremony of Saeppyol Street took place with splendor on Feb. 15.

Its venue was overflowing with emotion and joy of the bereaved families who would move into new flats amid the blessing of military and civilian builders, who constructed a unique new street true to the intention and will of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, and all other people across the country.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un attended the ceremony.
He was greeted by the commanding officers of Korean People's Army units involved in the overseas operations.
He met and exchanged warm greetings with them and extended militant salute to all the officers and men of the overseas operations units.

All the participants broke into cheers of emotion, looking up to the great father who has put the war heroes and their bereaved families on the meridian of glory and made a great history of noble love and obligation with ardent feelings of kinship.

The ceremony was attended by senior Party, government and military officials, members of the central leadership body of the Party, bereaved families of the war heroes, combatants and officers and men of the engineering unit who were dispatched for the overseas military operations, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, servicepersons of KPA units at all levels, builders, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools and citizens in Pyongyang.
Kim Jong Un made a speech in commemoration of the inauguration.

Saying with deep emotion that the meaningful day has come when Saeppyol Street has been completed thanks to the ardent desire of our motherland to have its address in our capital city, he noted that the inauguration of the street named Saeppyol that has already been etched in all our hearts as a byword for the glorious life of the combatants is an emotive moment when we record in the history of Pyongyang the most heroic era that embodies the strength of Korea, symbolizes the greatness of its people and has defended its sacred dignity and fame.

Noting that Saeppyol Street is a source of honour for our generation and a pride of Pyongyang and our state, he prayed for the immortality of the martyrs along with its inauguration which will etch the martyrs' names and images in history. He sincerely hoped that this street, a place where the ennobling souls rest and reverence from all over the country converges, will always brim over with joy and happiness.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.
Fireworks were displayed with enthusiastic cheers and numerous balloons with five-pointed star marks rose up to the sky.
Then the licenses for the use of flats were handed over to the bereaved families of the martyrs.
Kim Jong Un, together with senior Party, government and military officials, gave the licenses in the name of the WPK Central Committee to the bereaved families.

The bereaved families in tears of emotion extended their deep gratitude to the benevolent father who has repeatedly shown his boundless love and affection for them, filled with pain and remorse for failing to bring to their families the proud sons of the motherland who created the world-startling miraculous and heroic legends.
An art performance was given, shaking Saeppyal Street where the huge national flag of the dignified DPRK is flying high in the sky.

Touching the participants were the songs arousing boundless respect and noble reverence for the martyrs, who displayed mass heroism and unparalleled self-sacrificing spirit, hard to be seen in any other armies of the world, to demonstrate the combat power of our army to the whole world and unhesitatingly dedicated their lives to faithfully implementing the orders of the motherland.

When the national anthem of the DPRK, our heroes sang from the bottom of their heart in every field of decisive battles, wishing for its eternal prosperity, was played, the participants were all afire with a will to display their patriotic enthusiasm for further glorifying the dignity and honour of the motherland the martyrs defended at the cost of their lives.

A touching scene of great love and moral obligation was witnessed in Saeppyol Street, in which each flat is associated with the boundless benevolence of Kim Jong Un who has bestowed his warm affection and love for the war heroes on their families, ensuring that they enjoy the greatest happiness and glory.
Kim Jong Un met bereaved family members who would move into new houses.
