Noting that the inauguration of a street for the families of the fallen fighters in the overseas military operations reminds him of the heroic images of combatants who laid down their lives, praying for prosperity of their country and Pyongyang at their last moments, he said in an excited tone that it is the highest respect to the noble lives of the martyrs to make the country, associated with their desires and souls, richer and more beautiful and safeguard and glorify it.

Saying that the fallen fighters are model patriots and greatest heroes who unhesitatingly dedicated their precious lives to carrying out the order of the motherland for no reward, he stressed it is due obligation and noble mission of our Party and government to take care of the destiny and life of their parents, who brought them up to be excellent, and their wives and children, who were their strength and support, in the most responsible and sincerest manner.
He visited the house of Kim Jong Ok, widow of martyr O Thae Chol, and looked round its rooms and kitchen, listening to his family members' impression of the new house.

Saying she would miss her husband more than ever before in the new house, he hoped that she would overcome her sorrow as early as possible and lead a happy life. And he wished her son studying at the Mangyongdae Revolutionary School a bright future, saying that he should become an excellent person like his father.

Visiting the house of the couple Mun Ryong Mo and Ryu Sung Nam, whose twin sons dedicated their lives to the country, he said that thanks to such a patriotic family, the country grows stronger and steadily advances toward prosperity.
Saying that the Party and the government will entirely take care of the bereaved, he showed warm kinship affection, wishing them lasting happiness in their good houses.

He also visited the home of martyr Kim Tong Chun, twice Hero of the Republic, to wish his family members the best luck. The family members, greatly excited to have dream-like fortune, expressed their deep gratitude to him.

I think my anxieties have been removed a little, seeing the bereaved families who will lead a new beautiful life earlier than others in their houses in Pyongyang, he said, adding that the heroes, who performed the great exploits, to be etched in history, for the endless prosperity and mightiness of the country, and their families deserve the greatest glory and respect paid by the country and the people.

He repeatedly urged officials of the Party and power organs to thoroughly implement the measure taken to afford preference and privileges to the families of the martyrs, regarding it as an important policy task, and to always pay deep attention to their life so that they would never feel any inconvenience.
A historic moment, filled with parental affection of the great father, was captured in the street.
The families of the war martyrs, owners of a new street, looked round their new houses.
Seeing their houses furnished with all amenities, they keenly realized the great benevolence and love of Kim Jong Un and our Party.

Saeppyol Street, the crystal of eternal thanks and respect paid by the Party and the people to the heroes in the overseas military operations, will shed its rays for all ages along with its noble name, conveying a new legendary tale of love and moral obligation blooming in the great era of Kim Jong Un to posterity. -0-

fda73ad950e972ac25bd0433edbde903.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Inauguration Ceremony of Saeppyol Street
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech at the inauguration ceremony of Saeppyol Street on Sunday.
The full text of his speech is as follows:

Present here today are the bereaved family members of the fallen soldiers and other combatants as well as the combatants of the regiment of the engineers, who have been dispatched to the overseas military operations.

We are also here together with the commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, officers and soldiers of the units at all levels of the Korean People's Army, teaching staff and students of the revolutionary schools, and builders and Pyongyang citizens, who have been involved in the construction of Saeppyol Street.
Comrades,
The meaningful day has come when this street, to which the people across the country paid intense devotion and respect, has been completed to have its address in our capital city.

The new street has been built thanks to the ardent desire of our motherland that wishes that the precious lives of its excellent sons, who defended the most sacred things by sacrificing their most valuable things, will live forever. It is waiting for the moment when it will greet its honoured owners.

Thinking that my anxiousness would somewhat decrease if I brought this event even a day earlier, I have done my best and waited for this day to come. But now standing here, I rather feel sorry before feeling happy.

I once again extend the most ennobling respect to our proud martyrs, and, on behalf of the officers and soldiers of our army, Pyongyang citizens and all other people throughout the country, I offer consolation and thanks to all the bereaved family members of the fallen soldiers, the owners of this new street.

I also express deep thanks to the builders of the capital city, service personnel and officials and working people in the relevant sectors, who have wonderfully completed the street out of boundless respect for, and obligation to, our heroes.
Comrades,
Filled here is a solemn emotion that is quite different from what we felt whenever we saw the creations set up in various parts of the country.

The name Saeppyol Street has already been etched in all our hearts as a byword for the lives of the combatants, who sacrificed their all to their motherland so courageously to the last moments of their lives in the battlefields in a faraway alien land; this is something that others cannot perform throughout their life.

This is an emotive moment, when we record in the history of Pyongyang the most heroic era that embodies the strength of Korea, symbolizes the greatness of its people and has defended its sacred dignity and fame.
Saeppyol Street is a source of honour for our generation and a pride of Pyongyang and our state.
Dear bereaved family members of the martyrs,

With the construction of this street, the martyrs are now within hailing distance from the yards of their beloved families' houses, and they can feel the warmth of their kith and kin, whom they missed so much in the faraway alien land.

This is where the martyrs could feel the breathing of their dear family members every moment of the day; I would be most pleased if you live happily here generation after generation, priding yourself on having such excellent sons, husbands and fathers.

The comrades-in-arms who fought bloody battles with the martyrs, the families that have placed their dear children and husbands at the posts of national defence and all other people in this country will feel happy about today's inauguration; I believe that they sincerely hope the residents in the new street will lead a long and happy life here for the sake of the young martyrs.

Before their death, the heroic martyrs must have pictured in their mind's eye their dear families living in the ever-prospering country; the Party and the government will take all necessary steps to ensure that these families lead a proud and worthwhile life while enjoying the preferential treatment by the state and the loving care of the whole society.
I hope that this street, a place where the ennobling souls rest and reverence from all over the country converges, will always brim over with joy and happiness.
I am sure that this is the way to repay those who passed away.
Comrades,
We have the national flag of our dignified Democratic People's Republic of Korea hoisted on this street.
This is the flag which our combatants kept in their chests during bloody battles, and this is the one with which we covered the bodies of our admirable sons to bring them back to their motherland.

As the flag is shining its brilliance and fluttering in the wind, the martyrs' ennobling soul and pulsating hearts will give impetus to the development of our capital city, beautiful and thriving Pyongyang, and add eternal honour to our great motherland.
The moment when we are cutting the ribbon for the inauguration of the new street will be recorded as a moment of everlasting glory to etch the martyrs' names and images in history.
I pray for the immortality of our country's admirable sons.
Thank you. -0-

be4254720dbfa22f2f6d0a5cea60f827.title: Plan for Building 50 000 Flats in Pyongyang, Decided by Eighth Congress of WPK, Successfully Over-fulfilled Inauguration Ceremony of 10 000 Flats at Fourth Stage in Hwasong Area Held with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 17 (KCNA) -- The construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, powerfully carried on as the top-priority task of the historic Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, has been successfully concluded to be an epoch-making success in the new era of the comprehensive national rejuvenation.

Nearly 60 000 houses and public buildings with advanced civilization were built in Songsin, Songhwa and Hwasong areas to create new majestic and beautiful ideal streets of people, showing the eye-opening development of the people-first architecture, and a modern urban administrative district was formed. As a result, Pyongyang has been given a radical face-lift as befitting the capital city of socialist Korea in five short years.

With the over-fulfillment of the five-year plan for capital city construction, the WPK came to surely keep the promise it made to the people in the name of the dignified Party Congress. Through the struggle of past five years, experience like a textbook and a new standard of the Juche-oriented architecture have been created to dynamically guide the construction work on a nationwide scale that will be more widely conducted in the period of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK.

This eye-opening reality symbolizing the era of great changes is another precious fruition of the far-reaching plan and wise leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who set it as an honorable revolutionary task to turn Pyongyang into a world-class city where all desires of the people come true and has energetically guided the whole course of grand construction from the significant first ground-breaking. It is also an immortal great victory of our Party's idea of believing in the people as in Heaven.

An inauguration ceremony of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area, to conclude the five-year plan for monumental capital city construction, was held with splendor on February 16, the auspicious holiday of our state.

The venue of the inauguration ceremony was filled with high pride of the capital city builders, who provided the biggest labor gift to the Ninth WPK Congress by perfectly building grand architectural groups adding brilliance to the great era of Kim Jong Un under the flag of the housing construction headquarters for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang given by the Party Central Committee, and deep emotion and joy of Pyongyang citizens keenly witnessing the imposing era of prosperity of Pyongyang.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.

When he arrived, all the participants burst into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the great master of creation, the outstanding leader of the revolution who is vigorously ushering in a brilliant heyday of the comprehensive development of socialism where the people's dreams and ideals come true.

Present at the ceremony were members of the central leadership body of the Party, including senior Party, government and military officials, and officials of ministries and national agencies, working people to live in the new street, military-civilian builders, youth and students and Pyongyang citizens.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, addressed the ceremony.

Saying that we came to greet the moment of emotion proudly declaring that the construction plan for 50 000 flats in the capital city was over-fulfilled by far through the dynamic construction revolution in the great era of Kim Jong Un, the speaker extended warm congratulations and thanks on the occasion of the significant inauguration to all the builders of the capital city, service personnel, and officials and working people in the relevant fields who helped keep the promise made by the Party to the people.

The respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un ensured that the housing construction was surely carried out, irrespective of condition and environment, with it as the core of the construction policy set forth at the Eighth WPK Congress, saying that socialism should be built in the mind of the people first and the housing problem is a matter of their greatest interest, the speaker noted, adding: Thanks to his noble intention and steadfast will, the construction of 50 000 flats was given absolute significance as the Party's cherished desire and has been carried on powerfully and vigorously at all times from its dynamic start

The speaker told in an excited tone about the tireless efforts and boundless devotion made by the General Secretary with his ardent will that the true picture of the WPK is in the appearance of the thriving country and in the happy looks of the people and out of his mind to provide the working people with new dwelling houses on the same day and at the same hour as if they had fallen from the sky and to see their happy looks as soon as possible.

Those modern large architectural groups are a symbol of the great ideology and politics of the WPK which warmly embraces the people and holds them in high esteem as Heaven, a sacred fortress of the strongest single-minded unity that nothing can break, and a demonstration of the indomitable spirit and inexhaustible power of socialist Korea, the speaker said, and extended the warmest gratitude to Kim Jong Un, who is building a socialist paradise envied by the world on this land, in reflection of the unanimous mind of all the capital city builders, Pyongyang citizens and all other people across the country.

Stressing that it is the sacred duty and honor of the present generation to improve the appearance of the country through the dynamic construction revolution and create the richest and most civilized life with our wisdom and hands, the speaker called upon all the people to continuously work hard to glorify the capital city of Pyongyang as the most beautiful and great city in the world full of happiness of the people and realize the far-reaching goal of building a highly civilized and prosperous state at an early date under the new milestone of transformation to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.

The moment, fireworks were set off, confetti was thrown and lots of balloons rose up into the sky above the venue of the ceremony, which witnesses the auspicious event to be specially recorded in the new era of prosperity of Pyongyang, to beautifully decorate the sky of the capital city.

The participants paid the highest tribute to Kim Jong Un who regards it as the strongest national power when all the people are equally prosperous and cultivates a large flower garden of all blessings where all the people across the country lead the happiest life in bright laughter.
Kim Jong Un received bouquets of fragrant flowers from cute children.
He met workers who received new houses.
They expressed gratitude out of deep emotion. He wished them happiness in the wonderful houses and all the families who would move into new houses joy and happiness.

The citizens were filled with tears of gratitude, being embraced in the bosom of the benevolent father who made ordinary working people enjoy the privileges, that no other people in the world could imagine, and even gave them blessings of love.
Kim Jong Un met labor innovators who performed distinguished feats in the construction of the capital city.

Shaking hands with each of them, he said that thanks to the thoroughgoing implementers of the Party's policies like them, the important construction task decided by the Party could be successfully carried out and that the Party Central Committee would unfold a more gigantic construction project, believing in the revolutionary mettle of creation and fighting spirit of the capital city builders in the future, too. And he warmly encouraged them, hoping that they will once again fully display their honor and mettle as capital city builders in a new grand construction theater.

The capital city builders raised cheers of emotion, looking up to Kim Jong Un who attached importance to the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang as the forefront symbolizing the pioneering era of comprehensive rejuvenation, repeatedly showed them great love and trust in the whole period of the huge project, guided them to the creation of miracles and attributed all the successes to them.
There was a performance in celebration of the inauguration.

The Hwasong area reverberated with famous songs on patriotism singing highly of the greatest motherland where the people's paradise is being created with the principle of believing in the people as in Heaven.
The participants were filled with great joy while hearing the hymns of the era of great transformation in which a thriving power with the socialist civilization in full bloom is being built.
Solemnly played was the national anthem of the DPRK, the most advantageous people's country where all wealth is created for the people and enjoyed by the people from A to Z.

In the evening of the beautiful capital city, filled with the noble emotions peculiar to our state and people, the participants enthusiastically sang in chorus an all-people hymn "Dear Father" and beautiful fireworks were set off into the sky above the luxurious street.
Kim Jong Un looked round the new street in the Hwasong area.

The newly-built Hwasong area looks so beautiful for its majestic appearance of large architectural group embodying the advanced civilization and, more importantly, as it is associated with the genuine happiness and bright images of the people, he said, adding that today is a very significant day in the time-honored history of Pyongyang, the capital city.

Stressing that it is our Party's faith, absolute outlook on the people and thoroughgoing spirit of serving them to provide them with anything they want and everything for them under any circumstances, Kim Jong Un said that our Party will make strenuous efforts without a moment's stagnation and deviation to bring earlier the future in which our people will enjoy a civilized and affluent life to their heart's content.

The capital city construction should be steadily boosted, leading the development and civilization of our own style, he said, adding that the successes achieved so far are really great and precious but they are only beginning in comparison with our dreams and abilities. And he expressed his firm will to perfect the Hwasong area as a model district equipped with all political, economic and cultural components and turn the whole area of the capital city into the one embodying the features of the new era.

On the basis of the remarkable successes and experience achieved and gained in the period of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, the Ninth Congress of the WPK will clarify the greater milestone and goal of creation and our people will witness again another exciting five years of their perfect implementation, he said.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the wonderful new street.

At modern dwellings and peculiar service amenities embodying a harmony of the architectural formative art and advanced civilization, they were filled with boundless reverence for and trust in the motherly Party which translates all desires of the people into reality.

The successful completion of the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang proved before the whole world the truth that the Party's decision for the good of the people is science, practice and victory. And it is brilliantly recorded in the history of the country as an unprecedented construction miracle that convinced all the people that our capital city and the DPRK would prosper more wonderfully along the new road to the overall prosperity of socialism to be opened up at the Ninth Congress of the WPK. -0-

28646f0e81ca84ac3a08027127e54237.title: Fifth-Stage Construction of Hwasong Area Begins with Grand Ceremony in DPRK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- A ceremony of weighty significance was held in the area of Hwasong in the DPRK, well known as an epitome representing socialist Korea's remarkable advance toward a grandiose future and as a symbol of new construction miracles and high civilization. The ceremony demonstrates the spirit of continuous revolution and the engine for vigorous progress peculiar to the Workers' Party of Korea.

Thanks to the far-sighted plan and ambition of the WPK to accelerate the simultaneous and comprehensive prosperity of the whole country by turning its capital city into an ideal one representing the socialist cultural efflorescence admired by the world and making sure that the appearance of the capital city undergoing ceaseless progress is reflected in other parts of the country, the fifth-stage construction of the Hwasong area will start in the run-up to the glorious Ninth Congress of the WPK.

The grand construction campaign is to be conducted without a moment's let-up to show strenuous upsurges in the efforts for Pyongyang's prosperity in the new era and ever-soaring confidence in the development of Korean-style high civilization, at a time when loud cheers have been heard at the inauguration ceremonies celebrating the remarkable over-fulfillment of the five-year plan of the capital city construction set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK. This is a vivid manifestation of the noble people-first political ideals of the WPK racing against the clock to bring earlier a rosy future of the country through a resolute and offensive struggle.

A ceremony of declaring the start of the fifth-stage construction in the Hwasong area took place with splendor on February 18, adding to the confidence of the people in their Party and social system, their strength and cause.

The venue for the ceremony was brimming with great enthusiasm of the builders to write with pride a new history of transformations of their beloved capital city of Pyongyang by displaying more strongly the spirit and morale they had shown in building magnificent monumental edifices symbolic of their era and generation by upholding the Party's grand plan of capital city development with miraculous construction successes.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, attended the ceremony.
Present there were leading cadres of the Party, power and armed forces organs, officials of the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies, military-civilian builders and youth shock brigade members.

When Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue, all the participants raised enthusiastic cheers for a long time with deep reverence for the great revolutionary, benevolent father who is translating the centuries-old desire of the people into a brilliant reality of the present times, leading to steady progress and shining victory the historic advance towards the comprehensive development and prosperity of Korean-style socialist construction.
Kim Jong Un made a meaningful speech on the occasion of the start of the fifth-stage construction of the Hwasong area.

He noted that we will now launch into a construction project for the new year according the long-term plan for transforming our capital city of Pyongyang more wonderfully. Saying that with the beginning of the fifth-stage construction project in the Hwasong area today, the capital city construction that was basically aimed at solving the housing problem is switching over to a higher phase of transforming the overall appearance of the capital city on a large scale, he referred to the nature of the capital city construction and the goal and long-term plan to be attained in the next 5 years.

As befits the hub of our country and the origin of advanced culture and civilization, the capital city of Pyongyang should be perfect in all aspects and make uninterrupted progress, he said, adding that over the few years to come we will get rid of those elements that are inappropriate for the capital city in view of its overall formation and build modern streets and that this will bring about another facelift of the city, which will in turn augment its strategic position and role.

Expressing belief that all the capital city builders will wonderfully carry out the first task in the new plan period by pooling all their efforts and creativity and render a great contribution to glorifying this significant year, when the Ninth Party Congress will be held, as a successful year without fail, he ardently called on all to vigorously turn out once again for the capital city of the motherland.

When Kim Jong Un made a militant appeal at the end of his speech, the capital city builders and other participants raised passionate cheers in reflection of their ardent reverence for and trust in him.
Kim Jong Un dug the first spadeful of earth to signal the start of the fifth-stage construction of the Hwasong area and pressed the button of a detonator.
The thrilling explosion shook the earth, convincing all the participants of the everlasting heyday of Pyongyang, the capital city of our state.

Kim Jong Un extended his warm encouragement to all the builders filled with enthusiasm for glorifying the precious name and honor of the capital city builders by performing a miracle of legendary construction and more magnificently transforming the Hwasong area into an exemplary entity of the development and civilization of our own style perfectly embodying our Party's people-first idea and politics.

He repeatedly expressed belief that the officials of the construction headquarters and the capital city builders would always bear in mind the trust and expectation of the Party and the people and faithfully discharge their responsibility and role in the vanguard of the construction revolution in the new era and thus make the next five years the remarkable heyday when Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, will be transformed into the most beautiful city full of happiness of the people once again.

The start of the fifth-stage construction in the Hwasong area is a striking demonstration of the strong revolutionary spirit and power for great progress exclusive to the WPK which is advancing toward the far-reaching plan and goal for building a highly civilized and prosperous country, giving top priority to actualizing the people's long-cherished desire. -0-

4e4149896e8528913c7cc1ee012b4496.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Ceremony of Presenting Military Hardware
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech at a ceremony of presenting military hardware on Wednesday.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Comrades,
The workers in the munitions industry have prepared the most valuable present for a glorious congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
I propose to give warm applause, as a token of gratitude, to the workers and officials of the major munitions enterprise, who have come to the glorious Party congress with powerful military hardware.
You have performed really great feats.

The valuable fruition of your loyal labor struggle is an expression of your absolute support to and trust in the Party's cause and a meaningful success that highlights the historic significance of the Party congress.
It is a source of pride for the congress of our Party to greet this inspiring event at the most crucial and responsible moment.
As I see those military hardware standing in a fine array, I really cannot but admire at the strength and technology of our workers in the munitions industry and describe them as miraculous products.

I extend my warmest gratitude to the workers, technicians and officials of the factory and all other workers and scientists in the munitions industry, who have prepared the greatest and most significant creation for the Party congress by waging a mass struggle for increased production with the warm and sincere loyalty they have cherished.
Comrades,
The weapon we are seeing is called the 600mm super-precision multiple launch rocket system.
This is really a great weapon system.

As was outlined by the mass media some days ago, this is a focused strike weapon most powerful in the world. The precision and power of tactical ballistic missile and the multiple launching functions of tubes are perfectly combined in this weapon.
Obviously, it is a multiple launch rocket system, but it can be said to be a weapon that has virtually no difference from a high-precision ballistic missile in terms of precision and power.
It is really a wonderful and attractive weapon.
There is no need to further explain about its destructive power and military value.
This is because it can reduce the aimed target to ashes through surprise and simultaneous attack by focusing its destructive energy.
Those who have a passable knowledge may know that no other nations have got this kind of weapon system.

Appropriate for a special attack, that is, for accomplishing a strategic mission, it incorporates AI technology and compound guidance system. This large-calibre super-precision multiple launch rocket system, the one and only weapon in the world, has completely changed the role and conception of artillery accepted by modern warfare.
As I have already said, I am sure that no other countries in the world would be able to attain the technology that can match this class of weapon system within several years to come.
I am not allowed to talk about the principle and mode of using this weapon system.
Yet, I dare say it is more than clear that once this weapon is used, our belligerents' military infrastructure and command system will break down all at once.
When this weapon is used actually, no force would be able to expect God's protection.
Comrades,
Self-reliant defence capability is our lifeline and a source of our strength, and uninterrupted upgrading and rapid reinforcement of the means is our invariable target.
We will continue to demonstrate our achievements in defence technology that our geopolitical opponents will be greatly afraid of.
As I have mentioned several times, it will, on its own terms, be a responsible posture in exercising our deterrent.
It is undoubtedly a law and iron principle that the most powerful offensive capability constitutes the most reliable deterrent.
We must prepare such capability in reality and assure it with our own abilities, not in any spoken or written words.

To keep in mind a steadfast outlook on the enemy, build up the strongest military muscle and maintain a thoroughgoing offensive mode of counteraction--herein lies the basic guarantee for our state's security environment.
Comrades,

Availing ourselves of this meaningful opportunity, we have redoubled the confidence in our ever-upgrading and developing defence technology, as well as the will to modernize defence capabilities, which will be unshakable in any circumstances.
On the basis of this success, the Ninth Congress of our Party will make clear the next-stage plan and goal for strengthening the self-reliant defence capabilities.

Our undertaking for constantly upgrading the military strength capable of forcefully containing any threat and challenge by outside forces will be further accelerated, and this honorable struggle demands that our research group in the sector of national defence and our working class in the munitions industry work harder and make greater efforts.

I firmly believe that they will achieve more wonderful and inspiring successes in carrying out their important mission for meeting the demands of the revolution and executing the Party's strategic plan.

The Ninth Party Congress will extend warm respect and gratitude to our heroic defence scientists and working class in the munitions industry, who are boundlessly faithful to the cause of the Workers' Party of Korea.
I once again express my thanks for this meaningful ceremony.
Thank you. -0-

c05a45385fd04ed04560007ea16d9cd3.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Groundbreaking Ceremony of Fifth-stage Construction Project in Hwasong Area
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech at the groundbreaking ceremony of the fifth-stage construction project in the Hwasong area on Wednesday.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Comrades,
We will now launch into a construction project for the new year according to the long-term plan for transforming our capital city of Pyongyang more wonderfully.
This is just our struggle.

Inauguration yesterday and another groundbreaking today--we have been so busy, and now in the lead-up to a congress of the Workers' Party of Korea that will review its work over the past five years, we have to make a start once again without a moment of rest for a struggle for fresh creation and transformation. This is the mettle of our struggle, our aspiration, as well as a demand of the Korean revolution.
All the capital city builders who will participate again in the honorable project,
And the young vanguard who have come to the capital city construction site with soaring enthusiasm,
Comrades,
Let us make another start.
This Hwasong area really reflects our high ambition; it is symbolic of the civilization of our era, which gives a glimpse into the level of transformation we are going to achieve.

Construction in this area was planned and has been promoted with the aim of solving the housing problem of the people, but as you see, it has led to transformation, namely formation of an urban district. This can be called a great revolution in capital city construction and clear proof of our ideals and executive abilities.

The realms of our construction are expanding and its goals are getting higher with each passing day, and not only this Hwasong area but also all other parts of the country are undergoing transformation according to our will and the speed of their realization, from planning to implementation, is being further accelerated.

The country is changing its appearance and the wealth of the people is increasing each year, and along with this our revolution is following step by step the course of innovation and leap forward. This has become an irreversible trend of the revolution and a mode of its advance.
We should further accelerate this transformation and make it a permanent custom of socialist Korea to habitually witness new miraculous construction result in the days of seeing off a year.

This is never an easily attainable goal, but we have all with which we can surely reach it--the accumulated potential, self-confidence, wisdom, experience and capability; what is more important is that we have a large contingent of such faithful and reliable patriots as you.

This is our confidence and great strength that have been proved by the eye-opening successes in construction during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee and that have taken root deeper in our hearts today.
Comrades,
With the beginning of the fifth-stage construction project in the Hwasong area today, our capital city construction is going to switch over to a higher phase.

In other words, our capital city construction that was basically aimed at solving the housing problem is switching over to a new phase of transforming the overall appearance of the capital city on a large scale.

We should develop Hwasong District into an area perfect in every aspect as it has already acquired the qualities needed for a modern-day city, and then model the underdeveloped areas of the capital city after the district as we continue to make dynamic efforts for housing construction. Meanwhile, we should pursue steady progress to open a newer phase of civilization. This is the target we have to achieve in the coming stage of capital city construction.

By identifying the source of energy for struggle and the aim of steadfast development in its endeavors for the wellbeing of the people, our Party will find out new jobs and make persevering efforts to carry them out while regarding it as its supreme, thoroughgoing and consistent principle to look after the people with all sincerity by improving their standard of living in every way.
Recent years have witnessed considerable improvement in the living conditions of the citizens of the capital city, but we are not to feel content with this in any way.

We should push ahead with housing construction in the capital city with a long-term plan and without interruption by taking into account not only the families who are experiencing the trouble of sharing houses and those who are living in outdated houses but also those who are expected to come.

Along with this, we are planning some projects to open new service realms extensively to meet the growing cultural needs of the citizens and set up advanced bases to this end. In this way, we can make a facelift of the whole capital city and improve its function.
As befits the hub of our country and the origin of advanced culture and civilization, the capital city of Pyongyang should be perfect in all aspects and make uninterrupted progress.

Over the few years to come we will get rid of those elements that are inappropriate for the capital city in view of its overall formation and build modern streets. This will bring about another facelift of the city, which will in turn augment its strategic position and role.
Comrades,
The construction projects that are under way across the country are effecting one wonderful change after another, and these are a source of pride in our creative efforts.

The chronicles you are going to write with your courageous struggle will bring about a new upsurge in our overall grand construction, and the imprints of your heroic endeavors will be etched indelibly in the history of the construction revolution in the new era.
Our reliable young builders,
The Party and your country have placed a great trust in you when entrusting you with an important part of this construction project.

You should again demonstrate the mettle of young Koreans here in the Hwasong area with the passion with which you built Jonwi Street and a large country town, a source of pride of our socialist state, in a western border area of the country.

I firmly believe that all the capital city builders will wonderfully carry out the first task in the new plan period by pooling all your efforts and creativity and render a great contribution to glorifying this significant year, when the Ninth Party Congress will be held, as a successful year without fail.
Comrades,
Our Pyongyang should be the most beautiful and greatest city in the world.
This is our hope, our desire and our self-respect.
Let all of us vigorously turn out once again for the capital city of our motherland.
Forward towards our new great victory! -0-

fcb326cc8b6f984be38acc55d917caf1.title: Ceremony of Presenting 600mm-Calibre Multiple Rocket Launchers Held in DPRK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- The workers in the munitions industry of the DPRK are providing a sure guarantee for the continuous evolution and radical development of the self-defensive capability, giving a boost to invincibility and mightiness of our state in the outpost of the national defence industry revolution in the new era energetically led by the great Workers' Party of Korea. In this course, they presented 600mm-calibre multiple rocket launchers, carrying their spirit of devotedly implementing the Party's policies and fervent patriotism and loyalty, to the Ninth Congress of the WPK.

The workers of a leading munitions enterprise manufactured the main strike armaments as the most precious labor gift to give the strongest power to our heroic army through their indomitable struggle for creation and increased production in the van of the campaign to implement our Party’s idea of self-reliant defence – defending the state, the people and the revolutionary cause by our own efforts – and its strategic line on the development of the national defence.

A ceremony of presenting 600mm-calibre multiple rocket launchers to the Ninth Congress of the WPK by the workers of the munitions industry sector was held in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on February 18.

The absolute weapons, fully reflecting the patriotic soul of the soldiers of the national defence sector who devoted their all to the accomplishment of the historic mission to consolidate the self-defensive capacity as the strongest in the world and symbolizing the definite military superiority of the armed forces of the DPRK, were lined up in rows at the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture, demonstrating their might.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.

When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un appeared at the venue, all the participants extended the highest respect and glory to the invincible iron-willed commander who has opened a new horizon of developing the national defence in our own way and reliably defended the prestige and security of our state and people with his far-sighted wisdom, outstanding leadership ability and strong pluck, guiding the great cause of strengthening the national defence capability.
Present at the ceremony were the participants in the Ninth Congress of the WPK and officials, scientists, technicians and workers of the munitions industry sector.
An official of a munitions enterprise made a presentation report.

He respectfully reported to Kim Jong Un on presenting to the Ninth Congress of the WPK fifty 600mm-caliber multiple rocket launchers the workers of the enterprise additionally produced in two months, out of their mind to uphold the Party's cause of building a powerful army with their boundless patriotism and loyalty.

He courteously presented to Kim Jong Un the written donation reflecting the pledge of unshakable faith and loyalty of the workers in the munitions industry to uphold the revolutionary cause of the WPK with miraculous successes in the production of armaments.
Expressing thanks to it, Kim Jong Un made a reply speech.

Saying that the workers in the munitions industry prepared the most precious gifts to be presented to the Congress of the WPK, he courteously suggested making rapturous applause as a token of thanks to the workers and officials of the major munitions industrial establishment who have brought powerful war hardware to the venue for the glorious Party Congress.

It is a pride of our Party Congress to see such an encouraging advance at the most crucial and responsible time, he said, referring to the military value and efficiency of the world's most advantageous weapon for concentrated super-powerful attack and the invariable will of the WPK to modernize the capabilities for national defence.

Saying that the main guarantee for ensuring the national security environment lies in thoroughly maintaining the resolute outlook on the enemy, building up the most powerful military muscle and applying the offensive mode of response, he expressed belief that the research group in the sector of national defence and the workers in the munitions industry would attain more excellent and encouraging successes in their efforts for carrying out their weighty mission for fulfilling the requirements of the revolution and implementing the strategic plan of the WPK.
He awarded the Order of Kim Il Sung to the major munitions enterprise which has made distinguished exploits in carrying out the WPK's policy of defence industry revolution in the new era.
He presented the written donation of 600mm-calibre multiple rocket launchers to the chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army.
He personally drove a launcher vehicle to review the weaponry symbolic of absolute power lined in the plaza of the venue for the glorious Party Congress.

Thunderous cheers reverberated through the plaza that witnessed an exciting event to be specially recorded in the history of the WPK for accomplishing the great historic cause of building a rich country with a strong army.

Repeatedly expressing his satisfaction that the 600mm-calibre multiple rocket launchers are admirable military equipment making it possible to successfully carry out the strategic plan for rapidly developing the national war deterrence, he highly praised the workers in the munitions industry as the greatest revolutionaries and patriots who steadfastly uphold the cause of the WPK with their strong ideological and spiritual power and inexhaustible creativity.

The venue of presentation ceremony was filled with boundless gratitude to and reverence for the great teacher and benevolent father who led them to the historic Party Congress by making sure that they have unflinchingly left the proud traces of loyalty and feats, true to the mission they shouldered before the Party and the country, and put them on the platform of the glory paid by the whole country.

The workers in the field of munitions industry were full of ardent enthusiasm to make a dash to attain higher goals of bolstering up the national defence capabilities to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the WPK by dint of the invincible strength of trust, greater confidence and inexhaustible creativity, with which they follow their Party only.
After the ceremony, the delegates and observers of the Ninth Party Congress looked round the super-powerful military hardware presented to the Congress by the workers in the munitions industry.

The ceremony of presenting to the Ninth Congress of the WPK military hardware produced by the workers in the munitions industry will be recorded in history as a significant occasion for redoubling the unshakable will of all the people across the country to dynamically advance toward a new victory of the revolution, rallied close as one under the red flag of the WPK with firm faith in the validity and invincibility of their cause and absolute confidence in the future of the country which will be more powerful and prosperous. -0-

3f1bf7e176545833c0411816855c30d7.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Opening Address at Ninth Congress of WPK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made an opening address at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The full text of his opening address is as follows:
Dear delegates,
Today, we are opening the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, which will set up another new milestone in the sacred struggle for the development of our Party and socialist construction.

The past five years since the Eighth Congress of the WPK was a proud period when the whole Party and all the people brought about an epochal turn in implementing the socialist cause of our own style on the strength of solid unity.

Our socialist construction spanning long years has not been plain sailing, but never has there been such a period as this one, in which we achieved so great successes despite the severity of trials and difficulties.
When we convened the Eighth Party Congress, the subjective and objective conditions of our revolution were literally so harsh that we could hardly maintain our own existence.

The hostile forces grew more reckless in their schemes for harsh blockade and sanctions against us, and we were also confronted with successive natural calamities and the global public health crisis. This severely hindered the development of all our sectors, and it also seriously threatened the security of our state and the safety of our people.

Worse still, economic work in the country was being conducted in transitional and temporary ways just as it had been since several decades ago; all economic sectors were struggling to maintain the status quo without the orientation of their development.

Consequently, we were compelled to conclude the seventh term of the Party Central Committee as we fell fairly short of attaining the goals of the five-year strategy for national economic development that had been decided upon by the Seventh Party Congress.
However, everything has fundamentally changed today, five years from then.

The Eighth Party Congress critically reviewed and analyzed the unscientific nature of the above goals that had been pursued during the seventh-term Party Central Committee, before resolutely scrapping all that had gone out of date.

Given the then circumstances, it clarified the objectives of its work for the coming years and the direction for its development, and to this end put forward reasonable policies as regards the major theoretical and practical matters.
The plans for all the sectors were ambitious yet clear.

The work plans were drawn up and decided upon through strict scientific review and discussions, and they were based on the principle that we should achieve all that was within our power at the moment and do so without fail by making the seemingly impossible possible.

Even though they were facing difficult circumstances, the Party, the people and the army hardened their determination and made proactive efforts to this end; by successfully carrying out the Party's decisions in all realms such as politics, the economy, national defence, culture and diplomacy, they achieved notable, comprehensive and radical successes, and in the course of this, they substantially increased our country's internal forces.

In particular, the economic sector, which is the major front of socialist construction, fulfilled the five-year plan for national economic development in the main and made dynamic progress in reinforcing and readjusting the technical infrastructure and functions of the key industries. As a result, not a few sectors of our economy have freed themselves from the protracted obsolescence and stagnation, and instead built up their foundations and potentials to achieve significant growth under a plan.

And gigantic plans for transforming the capital city and the regions simultaneously and bringing about a substantial improvement in the people's living standards were pushed forward vigorously by the Party and the state; thus, the expected successes were achieved in these undertakings and a correct direction was confirmed for carrying them on more proactively.

In view of the external relations, too, the position of our state was firmly consolidated as an irreversible one, bringing about a great change in the global political landscape and in the influence on our state. This created favourable conditions and circumstances for giving a greater spur to our socialist construction.

Now all the people are witnessing every moment of the day the reality changing at a speed incomparable with that of the past, and have a clear understanding of and conviction about the road they should take and the prospect of the development of our state.

Five years ago we convened the Eighth Congress of the Party with the conviction, will and determination to break through the worst difficulties facing the revolution by our own efforts and usher in a new era of advance and development without fail, but today we are here at its Ninth Congress, filled with optimism and confidence in the future.
This is indeed a great change and development, as well as a success we can be proud of at the present stage.

Moreover, the precious successes achieved and monumental structures created in the course of the efforts to greet this Congress with high political enthusiasm and labour achievements rounded off the struggle of the past five years, thereby making this a congress that signifies a success and promises a greater success, both in name and in reality.

All the successes achieved during the period under review are a great gain from the devoted struggle our Party members, working people and service personnel have waged supporting the Party's lines and policies unyieldingly with one mind in the face of all difficulties.

I extend my heartfelt and warmest thanks to all the Party members, working people, service personnel and citizens for having turned the eighth term of the Party Central Committee into a period of great upsurge in socialist construction and made contributions to greeting the Ninth Party Congress as a precious one of reviewing, as a glorious one, with a staunch and proactive pioneering spirit and indomitable fighting spirit.

I also pay ennobling tribute to the revolutionary comrades and martyrs who dedicated their valuable lives to the sacred cause of achieving the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people during the period under review.

And my warm greetings go to Chongryon (General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) and other overseas compatriots' organizations and all the overseas compatriots that share will and mind for the prosperity and development of their socialist homeland.
Comrades,

This Congress will correctly review and analyze the work done during the period of the eighth term of the Party Central Committee, establish the lines and policies for developing our socialist construction onto a higher stage, and take organizational and institutional measures for readjusting and consolidating the Party's leadership ability.

Today, our Party is faced with heavy and urgent historic tasks of boosting economic construction and the people's standard of living and transforming all realms of state and social life as early as possible. This requires us to wage a more active and persistent struggle without allowing even a moment's standstill or stagnation.

In particular, the period of the new long-term plan is a crucial period when we should push forward full steam with the regional development policy in the new era, the rural revolution programme and other intermediate- and long-range plans we adopted and have launched to realize the centuries-old desire of the people.

In contrast, not a few serious shortcomings and negative elements, such as deep-rooted defeatism, irresponsibility, conservatism, formalism and immaturity in leadership ability, are latent at present in the work of the Party and government organs and officials, and this constitutes an artificial obstacle to the work of our Party and state which aspire to rapid development in all fields.

Therefore, we should not only take pride in the successes we achieved during the period under review but also review shortcomings from a critical and developmental point of view, work out the struggle plan for the next stage in an elaborate and scientific way and strengthen the leadership forces capable of leading the implementation of the plan.

Therefore, in preparing the Ninth Party Congress, the Party Central Committee focused on correctly drawing experience and lessons from the successes and shortcomings during the period under review and taking appropriate measures accordingly.

In order to make substantial preparations for the Party Congress, the Party Central Committee organized a non-permanent preparatory committee for the Congress, set up necessary panels and dispatched fact-finding groups according to directions and sectors to get them to gain a full understanding of the five-year work of the relevant sectors and units and to make a correct analysis of problems and their root cause.

And on the basis of their activities it assessed how the members of the eighth-term Party central leadership played their role and whether they correctly guided the development of their sectors and units.

Each field and each sector carried out the work of scientifically setting the goals and working out the plans for development to be achieved in the period of the new long-term plan and presenting them to the preparatory committee, and the departments of the Party Central Committee also presented innovative and detailed suggestions on the future plans and measures for carrying them out.

And there was an in-depth study of the issues arising in further enhancing the leadership functions of the Party in line with the requirements of the five-point Party-building line in the new era, including the issues related to the revision of Party Rules and the reorganization of the leadership forces of the Party.

In the run-up to the Party Congress, Party organizations at all levels reviewed the work of their leadership bodies by focusing on correctly drawing experience and lessons, and the election of delegates to the Party Congress and the nomination of observers were also completed.

Accordingly, the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee carried out a rigorous final examination of the qualifications of the delegates to the Party Congress who had been elected at provincial Party conferences.

The result of the examination appraised that all the comrades elected as delegates are fully qualified as they are core elements of our Party who have so far achieved marked results in improving the work of their sectors and units and who are capable of playing a significant role in the struggle to implement the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress in the future.
Participating in this Congress are 5 000 delegates in total--224 members of the eighth-term Party central leadership and 4 776 delegates elected by all Party organizations.

Among them are 1 902 delegates of Party and political workers, 747 delegates of state administrative and economic officials, 474 delegates of service personnel, 32 delegates of officials of working people's organizations, 321 delegates of officials in the sectors of science, education, public health, sports, culture and art and the mass media, and 1 524 delegates of officials and hard-core Party members involved in field labour.
Of them 413 are women.
The Congress is also attended by 2 000 observers nominated by Party organizations at all levels, including officials from the departments of the Party Central Committee.
Dear delegates,
We are now at this significant venue with the high honour and heavy mission of being delegates to the Party Congress, entrusted by all the Party members in reflection of their organizational will.

So great are the concern and expectations of all the Party members and other people across the country for the Ninth Party Congress, which will mark another watershed in our Party's sacred struggle to realize the rights, interests and long-cherished desires of the people. And all of us have shouldered a heavy mission of making sincere, active and responsible efforts to ensure that the Congress does its work satisfactorily.

Solemnly pledging, on behalf of all the participants in this Congress, the ninth of its kind in the glorious history of the Workers' Party of Korea, that the Congress will be absolutely faithful to the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism,

And fully convinced that the Congress will be a significant, historic occasion vigorously guiding the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche thanks to the high political consciousness and enthusiasm of all the delegates,
I declare the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea open. -0-

a4ba97d609215a9d811b0289753146c9.title: Ninth Congress of WPK Opens with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- All the Party members and other people in the DPRK, absolutely convinced that the Korean revolution would always emerge victorious thanks to the outstanding ideas, strong fighting efficiency and seasoned leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, extend the highest tribute and warm congratulations to the Ninth Congress of the WPK, a political event to be specially recorded in the ever-victorious history of the Party's guidance.
The Ninth Congress of the WPK opened with splendor in Pyongyang, the capital city of the revolution, on February 19.

The Party Central Committee, which has perseveringly guided the first-stage pioneering struggle for transformation aimed for achieving the comprehensive development of socialism under the uplifted banner of the idea of believing in the people as in Heaven, single-hearted unity and self-reliance, convened the Party congress, the ninth of its kind in the history of the WPK, to review its work in the period under review and set scientific goals for struggle and policies in line with the requirements of the new revolutionary stage.

The Ninth Party Congress, convened to indicate a new bright prospect in the stirring period faced with the crucial changes and the era of great prosperity unprecedented since the foundation of the Party and the state, is a manifestation of the solemn intention of the WPK to remain boundlessly faithful to the general will of the people and vigorously guide the cause of Juche to a fresh victory and steady upsurge.

The past five years, which witnessed the forward movement along the milestone of the struggle set up by the Eighth Congress of the WPK, were the most responsible and acute process decisive of the long-term development of our Party and state, and our Party powerfully demonstrated the prestige and heroism of our state and people by maintaining its definite strategic edge and accelerating the advance of socialism in the grim situation characterized by unprecedented arduousness and fierceness.

Thanks to the revolutionary and scientific leadership of the WPK, our state and people entered the phase of radical turn to the overall national development with historic delight, brought about a great transformation to practically prove the socialist cultural efflorescence and won a great victory in providing a decisive guarantee for the next-stage upsurge.

For the WPK which proves the mightiness and invincibility of the cause of Juche with entities of a rich country with a strong army under the banner of great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, it is the most sacred duty entrusted by the country, revolution and people to unfold a blueprint for continuous new victory of Korean-style socialism on behalf of the destiny, future, faith and resourcefulness of millions of party members and tens of millions of people.

Delegates of the whole Party entered the venue of the Ninth Congress of the WPK with active enthusiasm to faithfully perform and exercise the honorable mission and rights they have assumed before the Party and the revolution.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, took the platform of the congress together with members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK.

All the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who is leading the revolutionary cause of Juche along the road of one victory after another with his gifted ideo-theoretical wisdom and extraordinary leadership practice and making our Party and people have the dignity and honor that will shine for all ages.
Present at the congress were members of the eighth-term Party central leadership and delegates and observers elected from organizations at all levels of the whole Party.
Kim Jong Un made an opening address at the Ninth Congress of the WPK.

He said that the past five years since the Eighth Congress of the WPK was a proud period when the whole Party and all the people brought about an epochal turn in implementing the socialist cause of our own style on the strength of solid unity. We convened the Eighth Congress of the WPK five years ago with the conviction, will and determination to break through the worst difficulties facing the revolution by our own efforts and usher in a new era of advance and development without fail, but we are here at the Ninth Congress filled with optimism and confidence in the future, he said, adding that this is a great change and development as well as a success we can be proud of at the present stage.
He declared the congress open, solemnly pledging on behalf of all the participants in the congress that the Congress will be absolutely faithful to the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism.
The national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played.
Upon authorization of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Jo Yong Won presided over the congress.
The congress elected its presidium.
The presidium of the congress is as follows:
Kim Jong Un,

Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, Ri Il Hwan, Pak Jong Chon, Ri Hi Yong, Jo Chun Ryong, Kim Tok Hun, Choe Tong Myong, Choe Son Hui, No Kwang Chol, Ri Pyong Chol, Jong Kyong Thaek, Ri Yong Gil, Kim Jae Ryong, Pak Jong Gun, Kim Jong Gwan, Ju Chang Il, Kim Hyong Sik, Han Kwang Sang, Ju Chol Gyu, Kim Song Nam, Ri Chol Man, Ri Chang Dae, Pang Tu Sop, Kim Chol Won, Kim Su Gil, Kang Yun Sok, Jon Sung Guk, Kim Myong Hun, Jong Myong Su, Kim Jong Sun, O Il Jong, Kim Jong Sik, Kim Yo Jong, Ko Pyong Hyon, Jang Ki Ho and Choe Kun Yong
The congress recommended members of the platform.

The platform of the congress was taken by the chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK, members of the Party central leadership who faithfully fulfilled their duties in implementing the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK, and officials who performed distinguished feats amid the enthusiastic applause of the participants.
Present there on invitation were Kim Ho Chol, chairman of the C.C., Korean Social Democratic Party, and Ri Myong Chol, chairman of the C.C., Chondoist Chongu Party.
The congress elected its secretariat.
The secretariat of the congress is as follows:
Kim Pong Chol, Ju Un Chol, Sin Chol Man, Choe Chang Hak and Choe Hak Gun
The congress approved the following agenda items.
First, Review of the work of the WPK Central Committee
Second, On the revision of the WPK rules
Third, Election of the central leadership body of the WPK
The Ninth Congress of the WPK started the discussion of the first agenda item amid the extraordinarily high political awareness and enthusiasm of all the delegates. -0-

12b6b7ba363e72c0815c731c0cbf3f6d.title: Second-day Sitting of Ninth Congress of WPK Held Comrade Kim Jong Un Starts Report Reviewing Work of Eighth-term WPK Central Committee
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 21 (KCNA) -- The second-day sitting of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea took place on Feb. 20. The congress will mark a new milestone in the development of the Party and the history of comprehensive socialist construction.
The congress continued its discussion on the first agenda item "Review of the Work of the WPK Central Committee" as it did in its first-day sitting.

After hearing about the implementation of the Party and state policies during the period under review, the congress appreciated that the remarkable successes, experience and lessons, gained in the overall work of the Party and the state in politics, economy, culture, defence, diplomacy and other fields under the leadership of the eighth-term Central Committee of the WPK headed by the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, serve as the precious foundations for putting the struggle onto the next-stage development process and as a springboard for making leaps forward in guaranteeing greater changes and successes.

The past five years, which witnessed the strenuous efforts to go through the first-stage course towards the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialist construction, were a period of great transformations and turns of profound significance in building up the Party struggling to realize the independence of the popular masses and developing the revolution.

The Party Central Committee has consistently adhered to the responsible working attitude of finding shortcomings first rather than successes and learning the secret to development from lessons in adopting Party policies and drawing up and carrying out work, and to the principle of attaching absolute importance to the interests of the state and the people. It has also opened up a new chapter, in which the whole country undergoes progress in a simultaneous and balanced way, steering the trend of accelerated changes in all fields of socialist construction.

Amid the struggle for implementing the five-point Party-building line in the new era, the Party's leadership, organizing ability and fighting efficiency have been further strengthened, alongside the creation of appearance and traits for ensuring the eternal continuity of the glorious 80-year-long ruling history of the Party. Furthermore, the five-year plans in all fields, decided by the Eighth WPK Congress, were successfully carried out and creations of prosperity built in all parts of the country to fully demonstrate the daily-growing political and economic potentials of the DPRK, thanks to the great spirit and irresistible might of all the Party members and other people united with patriotism.

The congress acknowledged that through the struggle, guided by the eighth-term Central Committee of the WPK, for fresh innovation, bold creation and steady advance, the internal force has remarkably increased to lay a scientific development foundation for putting all fields of socialist construction on a new stage and secure confidence and sufficient ability for further accelerating the struggle for the prosperity of the state.

The second-day sitting of the congress heard an important report of weighty historic and practical significance in making the pioneering period of the comprehensive development of socialism lead on to the greatest-ever upsurges.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un started the report on the review of the work of the eighth-term Central Committee of the WPK.

All the participants listen carefully to the historic report on the review of the work of the WPK Central Committee which proudly reviews the five years when it brought about eye-opening development and change by waging an offensive struggle with absolute trust in its cause and strong fighting spirit. -0-

b1d9f336fa4c33df606e9417320123cb.title: Third-day Sitting of Ninth WPK Congress Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Report Reviewing Work of Eighth-term C.C., WPK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 22 (KCNA) -- The Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea is intensifying the most comprehensive political activities in carrying out its leadership mission as the political staff of the socialist cause.
The third-day sitting of the congress was held on Feb. 21.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un continued his report on the review of the work of the eighth-term Party Central Committee.

The report made an in-depth analysis of the Party Central Committee's work in the period under review, during which it has fulfilled its important mission and role as the vanguard of the revolution, ushering in a new era of unprecedented changes and upsurge in the scope and depth of struggle and speed of development. The whole audience was deeply moved by the report filled with the boundless pride of having ushered in a new heyday of strengthening the whole Party and having pioneered a new irreversible trend of the comprehensive national rejuvenation.

It clarified the new fighting strategy corresponding to the strong spirit of advance of the country and the people and their full confidence and specified the prospective goals for all sectors and the tasks and ways for attaining them.

The participants further hardened their confidence in the bright future of their cause, attentively listening to the report consistent with the invariable will to put the overall socialist construction on the track of sure prosperity and leaps forward over the next five years by making more vigorous and dynamic efforts in the most important stage deciding the success of our cause on the basis of the valuable achievements gained through arduous struggle and the profound review of them.

The delegates expressed full support to General Secretary Kim Jong Un's significant report that will serve as a milestone in promoting the steady development of our great Party and the historic process towards a powerful country.

The congress unanimously recognized that the report on the review of the work of the eighth-term Central Committee of the WPK is a revolutionary guideline for the struggle to make all victories and glories gained during the period under review lead on to more rapid development, faster change and greater progress by adhering to consciousness of innovative and offensive struggle and mode of advance.
Speeches were made on the first agenda item.

Speeches were made by Jang Kyong Guk, chief secretary of the Sinpho City Committee of the WPK who is a delegate of the South Hamgyong provincial Party organization, and Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui, a delegate of the Pyongyang municipal Party organization.

The speakers expressed their strong support and approval for Kim Jong Un's report which comprehensively deals with the mature demand of the Korean revolution in transition to a new stage of development, the scientific line of struggle and strategic and tactical issues.
All the participants are taking an earnest approach to the important discussion, full of firm readiness, confidence and conviction. -0-

271f20d093bbeaa6cca678c0f0821438.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Elected as General Secretary of WPK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- A decision of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea "On Election of the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea" was adopted on Feb. 22.
The decision is as follows:

Today our revolutionary cause for the comprehensive socialist construction is making a dynamic advance, achieving unprecedented miracles at an extraordinary speed under the experienced and seasoned leadership of the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea.

At the Ninth Congress of the WPK held in the annals of the stirring struggle for making great and epochal changes unprecedented in the history of the DPRK's growth and development while braving all challenges and difficulties of history, all the Party members and people are to make an important decision on electing the head of the WPK, the centre of leadership and unity who embodies the organizational will of the whole Party.

To elect the head of the WPK who assumes the heavy responsibility for guiding the state and the people to the victory of the socialist cause is of greatest significance in the work of the Party Congress, the supreme leadership body of the Party, as it is an important affair decisive of the Party's leadership ability and the future destiny of the country and the people.
The attention of millions of Party members and all the people is now focused on this decision.
The current Congress fully supported and approved the polite proposal for re-electing Comrade Kim Jong Un as the top leader of the WPK.

This is the historical appraisal of the past five-year struggle, in which epochal changes had been made with the august name of Comrade Kim Jong Un as the banner of invincibility, and its great fruition and an expression of the responsible and solemn stand reflecting the choice and will of all the people.

At a turning point in which the noble ideology and ideal our Party has adhered to in its protracted and sacred history are being translated into gigantic reality and the new era of building a strong and prosperous state is being ushered in on the path of the Juche revolution, all the Party members and other people of the country and all servicepersons of the armed forces of the Republic are making a pledge of loyalty to invariably hold in high esteem Comrade Kim Jong Un as the centre of unity and leadership, cherishing the immutable truth that the greatness of Kim Jong Un is the guiding power of our Party, the might of our state and the glory of socialism.

Kim Jong Un is the most prominent statesman who has performed great exploits before the country and the revolution and on behalf of the times and history by leading our Party and people only to victory with his rare ideo-theoretical wisdom, distinguished leadership ability and noble popular traits and the only person who can represent the mightiness and invincibility of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, our great state.

Holding fast to great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as the guiding idea of our Party and bringing about a radical turn in the Party building and activities, he has thoroughly maintained the revolutionary character of the WPK as the powerful political staff which established the oneness of ideology and leadership and as an invincible party which has served the people and become a harmonious whole with the popular masses.

He set forth the five-point Party-building line in the new era and has energetically led the struggle for its implementation and thus developed the WPK into a party, politically mature, organizationally strong, ideologically pure, strict in discipline and sound in work style. This is an immortal exploit that provided a decisive guarantee for building up the political force which powerfully guides the Korean revolution and socialist construction to upturn and carrying forward the leadership ability of our Party for all ages.

He clarified a new-stage goal for the comprehensive development of our own style socialist construction and clear programme with obvious possibility and ushered in an era of change and innovations unprecedented in the history of the Republic with his correct and original revolutionary leadership.

He set forth the scientific fighting policy for the stable development of the self-supporting economy, brought about precious successes in implementing the five-year plan and developing the overall economy, laid a solid material foundation for the economic and cultural development and improvement of the people's standard of living through a great upsurge in the construction revolution and opened up an eye-opening reality in which the appearance of the country was radically changed in a short span of time.

It is the historic exploit that can be achieved only by Kim Jong Un that the gigantic revolution started to eliminate the backwardness of regions and rural areas, which had remained as the fetters of development for a long time, and improve the material and cultural environment of the country and the eternal foundation for comprehensive prosperity has been consolidated as its brilliant fruition.

The epochal results have been made in the healthcare revolution for reconstructing the medical field of the country in an advanced way and remarkable achievements made in the fields of science, education, sports, literature and arts one after another. This is the fruition of the outstanding leadership of Kim Jong Un who has pioneered a high stage of development of the state, guiding all fields of socialist construction.

Clearly recorded in the history of the Party and the country are the outstanding leadership mode and sacred annals of the revolutionary activities of Kim Jong Un who has made sure that the might of single-minded unity with patriotism is steadily displayed, boosting the pride and self-esteem of Koreans with his great examples, and trained a large contingent of reliable socialist builders and successors faithful to the country and the revolution through practical struggle.
